files.text:
' Game - LITTLE SEOUL, on THE LITTLE SEOUL ENGINE (City.bas). You're Seoul's newest postie. Every
' working day for four weeks you leave the Central Post Office in Myeongdong with a bag of letters and
' parcels and walk them round the city: the hundred people of the town at their addresses, shops,
' flats up in the lifts, strangers who ignore you. Crazy Taxi on foot: the clock runs from 9:00 to 18:00.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' Keys: Q A O P (or a joystick) walk, Space talks / picks / goes on, M the bag and the map (and back),
' T hyperspace.
'
' THIS FILE IS THE GAME - everything the city doesn't decide. For a new game replace it (docs/NEWGAME.md):
'   1. the start: CityStart (the city's start-up), then your own loop - here the title, a new
'      postie, then a season of days (Season -> OneDay -> Round, City.bas's frame loop)
'   2. the subs City.bas calls (City.bas's header has the list): Clockwork, Hud, HudTime, Stat,
'      Feel, BagScreen, Knock, Mailbox, Counter, AfterShop, BagFor, ItemWords, Delivered
'   3. your state: Public variables here; the city's (where you are, the clock) are City.bas's
'   4. your story: scripts/POST.txt and DELIVER.txt are this game's; CHAT, SHOPS, STRANGERS and
'      THINGS are the city's voices (tools/storyc.py makes them all into Data.cls's scenes)
Option Explicit
Option Turbo

' the stats (the script's !STAT numbers)
Public Const S_ENERGY = 0, S_SPEED = 1, S_BOSS = 2, S_REP = 3, S_TIME = 4, S_LOOKUP = 5, S_APP = 6, S_HAIR = 7, S_LOOK = 8
Public Const S_HANBOK = 9, S_FLOWERS = 10, S_ASK = 11
Public Const BAGMAX = 12
' the clock: minutes from midnight
Public Const T_START = 540
' the cast's faces (9 bytes each), who they are (-1: nobody in particular), how the town feels
Public myLook(8) As Byte
Public male As Integer, me As Integer
' the bag: whose (a person, or -1 a shop's), the building, floor, flat, letter 0 / parcel 1, done, from
Public bFloor(11) As Byte, bUnit(11) As Byte, bFrom(11) As Byte
Public nDone As Integer
Public tickM As Integer, rep As Integer
Public strikes As Integer, total As Integer, totalDone As Integer, hanbok As Integer
Public wantHair As Integer, hungry As Integer

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the game starts here
CityStart
Do
  TitleScr
  NewMe
  Season
Loop

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- your stats
Sub Stat(ByVal s As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
  Select Case s
    Case S_ENERGY
      energy = Clamp(energy + v)
      If v > 0 Then Fx 200, 120, 7
    Case S_SPEED
      speedT = speedT + v
    Case S_BOSS
      boss = Clamp(boss + v)
      If v > 0 Then Fx 200, 120, 1 Else Fx 200, 120, 9
    Case S_REP
      rep = Clamp(rep + v)
    Case S_TIME
      mins = mins + v
    Case S_LOOKUP, S_ASK
      lookup = 1
    Case S_APP
      hasApp = 1
    Case S_HAIR
      wantHair = 1
    Case S_LOOK
      pPal = 1 + (pPal Mod 10)
    Case S_HANBOK
      hanbok = 1
    Case S_FLOWERS
      flowers = flowers + 1
  End Select
End Sub

Sub Feel(ByVal v As Integer)
  If themP < 0 Then Exit Sub
  v = aff(themP) + v
  If v < 0 Then v = 0
  If v > 100 Then v = 100
  aff(themP) = v
End Sub

' Won(v): v hundreds of won as W12,500
Function Won(ByVal v As Integer) As String
  Dim s As String, a As Integer
  a = Abs(v)
  If a >= 10 Then
    s = CStr(a \ 10) & "," & CStr(a Mod 10) & "00"
  ElseIf a > 0 Then
    s = CStr(a) & "00"
  Else
    s = "0"
  End If
  If v < 0 Then s = "-" & s
  Won = "W" & s
End Function

' the top and bottom lines
Sub Hud()
  Board.Rect 0, 0, 40, 3, 0, 0
  Board.Rect 0, 28, 40, 4, 0, 0
  Board.Text 2, 1, "DAY " & CStr(day), C_GOLD
  Board.Text 9, 1, Clock(), C_WHITE
  Board.Text 16, 1, Won(money), C_MINT
  Board.Text 25, 1, "BAG " & CStr(nDone) & "/" & CStr(nBag), C_PINK
  Bar 36, 1, 3, energy, energy > 25
  If inShop >= 0 Then
    If floors > 1 Then txt = placeS & " " & CStr(floor) & "F" Else txt = placeS
  Else
    txt = distS
    If rc(194) And 4 Then txt = TabStr(Data.W_BRIDGES, (room Mod 16) * 16, 16)
  End If
  Board.Text 2, 29, Left$(txt, 36), C_WHITE
End Sub

Sub HudTime()
  Board.Text 9, 1, Clock(), C_WHITE
  Bar 36, 1, 3, energy, energy > 25
End Sub

' the clock: a minute every half a second; you get hungry
Sub Clockwork()
  tickM = tickM + 1
  If tickM < 25 Then Exit Sub
  tickM = 0
  mins = mins + 1
  If speedT > 0 Then speedT = speedT - 1
  If (mins Mod 6) = 0 And energy > 0 Then energy = energy - 1
  OffStage
  HudTime
  If energy = 20 And hungry = 0 Then
    hungry = 1
    Talk Data.TH_HUNGRY, K_YOU
  End If
  If energy = 0 Then
    Talk Data.TH_TIRED, K_YOU
    mins = mins + 30 : energy = 25
    Hud
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the bag
' the bag's item for building s (flat f, or any: -1), not yet delivered (-1 none)
Function BagFor(ByVal s As Integer, ByVal fl As Integer) As Integer
  Dim j As Integer
  BagFor = -1
  For j = 0 To nBag - 1
    If bDone(j) = 0 And bShop(j) = s Then
      If fl < 0 Or bFloor(j) = fl Then BagFor = j : Exit Function
    End If
  Next
End Function

Function FromName(ByVal kk As Integer) As String
  Dim s As String, t As Integer, p As Integer, q As Integer, k As Integer
  k = kk
  If k < 8 Then
    s = "MUM|GRANDMA|A BANK|THE TAX OFFICE|A FAN|AN ONLINE SHOP|A SECRET ADMIRER|THE GAS COMPANY"
  Else
    s = "A COUSIN|THE UNIVERSITY|A LAWYER|AN OLD FRIEND|THE LOTTERY|A PEN PAL|THE COUNCIL|DAD"
    k = k - 8
  End If
  p = 1
  For t = 0 To k
    q = InStr(p, s & "|", "|")
    If t = k Then FromName = Mid$(s, p, q - p) : Exit Function
    p = q + 1
  Next
End Function

Sub ItemWords(ByVal j As Integer)
  If bKind(j) Then itemS = "PARCEL" Else itemS = "LETTER"
  tokT = FromName(bFrom(j))
End Sub

' item j delivered: pay, tips, hearts (by hand / to them / left / in the mailbox: how 0 - 3)
Sub Delivered(ByVal j As Integer, ByVal how As Integer)
  Dim tip As Integer
  bDone(j) = 1 : nDone = nDone + 1 : totalDone = totalDone + 1
  Ding
  tip = 0
  If how <= 1 And bP(j) >= 0 Then
    If aff(bP(j)) >= 40 Then tip = 10 + (aff(bP(j)) \ 20) * 5
    Feel 2
  End If
  If how = 0 Then tip = tip + 20
  If bKind(j) Then money = money + 30 + tip Else money = money + 15 + tip
  rep = Clamp(rep + 1)
  If how <= 1 Then Fx px + 32, py + 16, 10 Else Fx px + 32, py + 16, 14
  If nDone = nBag Then Fx px + 32, py + 8, 14 : Fx px + 40, py + 12, 3
  Hud
End Sub

' knock at flat u on floor fl of building s (a house: 1, 1)
Sub Knock(ByVal s As Integer, ByVal fl As Integer, ByVal u As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer, p As Integer, home As Integer
  Sfx.Play 1, 600, 0, 13, 4, 1 : WaitF 8 : Sfx.Play 1, 600, 0, 13, 4, 1 : WaitF 20
  ' who lives here?
  p = -1
  For j = 0 To 99
    If HomeAt(j) = s And tb(2) = fl And tb(3) = u Then p = j
  Next
  j = -1
  For k = 0 To nBag - 1
    If bDone(k) = 0 And bShop(k) = s And bFloor(k) = fl And bUnit(k) = u Then j = k
  Next
  If j >= 0 Then
    ItemWords j
    If p < 0 Then
      ThemNobody "RESIDENT", s * 7 + u, 1 + (s + u) Mod 4
    Else
      ThemIs p
    End If
    If p >= 0 Then home = (WhereAt(p, mins) = s) Else home = ((day + fl + u) Mod 3) <> 0
    If home Then
      If p >= 0 And aff(p) >= 60 Then Play Data.DE_FRIEND01 + Rnd(6), K_THEM Else Play Data.DE_DLV01 + Rnd(16), K_THEM
      Face.Hide 0 : TalkOff
      Delivered j, 1
    Else
      Talk Data.DE_AWAY01 + Rnd(4), -1
      Delivered j, 2
    End If
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If p >= 0 Then
    If WhereAt(p, mins) <> s Then p = -1
  End If
  If p >= 0 Then
    ThemIs p
    If flowers > 0 Then
      flowers = flowers - 1
      Talk Data.DE_GIFT, K_THEM
    Else
      Talk Data.DE_KNOCKED, K_THEM
    End If
    Exit Sub
  End If
  ThemNobody "NEIGHBOUR", s * 3 + fl * 5 + u, 1 + (fl + u) Mod 4
  Talk Data.DE_WRONG01 + Rnd(8), K_THEM
End Sub

' the mailboxes in a lobby: every letter for this building goes in
Sub Mailbox()
  Dim j As Integer, c As Integer
  c = 0
  For j = 0 To nBag - 1
    If bDone(j) = 0 And bShop(j) = inShop And bKind(j) = 0 Then
      If c = 0 Then Talk Data.DE_MAILBOX, -1
      Delivered j, 3 : c = c + 1
    End If
  Next
  If c = 0 Then Note "NOTHING FOR " & placeS & "." : RoomText
End Sub

' the counter: whoever's behind it
Sub Counter()
  Dim j As Integer, id As Integer
  LoadType sType
  ThemNobody TabStr(Data.W_TYPES, (sType) * 64 + 32, 10), inShop, ty(5)
  If sType = Town.TY_POST Then
    cst(K_THEM) = cst(K_BOSS) : themP = -1
    For j = 0 To 8
      cLook(9 + j) = cLook(18 + j)
    Next
  End If
  ' a delivery for the shop?
  j = BagFor(inShop, -1)
  If j >= 0 And bP(j) < 0 Then
    ItemWords j
    Talk Data.DE_BIZ01 + Rnd(8), K_THEM
    Delivered j, 1
    Exit Sub
  End If
  id = Data.SH_CAFE + sType
  If sType = Town.TY_TOWER And floor > 1 Then id = Data.SH_VIEW
  Talk id, K_THEM
  AfterShop
End Sub

' what the shop did to you
Sub AfterShop()
  If wantHair Then
    wantHair = 0
    myLook(2) = (myLook(2) + 1 + Rnd(6)) Mod 15
    cLook(2) = myLook(2)
  End If
  Hud
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the title
Sub TitleScr()
  Dim j As Integer, t As Integer
  Blank
  talking = 0
  GameSet.Load Data.GAMEPAGE
  fxBase = GfxData.S_ICON : fxFl = Spr.Pal * 15
  LoadRoom 4 * 16 + 6
  World.Draw VarPtr(rc)
  L2.Big 24, 18, "LITTLE", 4, &HFF, &H00
  L2.Big 56, 58, "SEOUL", 4, &HE0, &H00
  Mid1 22, "SEOUL'S NEWEST POSTIE", C_GOLD
  Mid1 24, "SPACE: START", C_WHITE
  Mid1 29, "(C) 2026 CYBORG UNICORN", C_GREY
  tune = 1 : beat = 0
  t = -40
  Do
    Tick
    t = t + 2
    If t > 300 Then t = -40
    Spr.Put SP_YOU, t + 32, 120, GfxData.S_POSTIE + 7 + ((frames \ 5) And 1), 0
  Loop Until Key() = 5
  tune = 0
  FxClear
  Sfx.Play 0, 100, -2, 14, 20, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- making you
Sub NewMe()
  Dim sel As Integer
  Blank
  Backdrop
  sel = 1 + YesNo("SEOUL'S NEW POSTIE IS...", "A MAN", "A WOMAN")
  male = 1 - sel
  TalkOn
  me = PickFace(sel)
  LoadRec me
  For k = 0 To 8
    myLook(k) = rec(8 + k)
  Next
  pName = PNameOf(me)
  Blank
  Backdrop
  Face.Put 0, VarPtr(myLook), 144, 168, 2, 0, 0
  NameEntry
  Face.Hide 0
  Cast
End Sub

' the Postmaster and your colleague; everyone's feelings
Sub Cast()
  Dim p As Integer
  For k = 0 To 99
    aff(k) = 20 : met(k) = 0
  Next
  cst(K_YOU) = me
  For k = 0 To 8
    cLook(k) = myLook(k)
  Next
  Do
    p = Rnd(100)
  Loop Until p <> me
  cst(K_BOSS) = p : LookOf K_BOSS, p
  cLook(K_BOSS * 9 + 3) = 6
  Do
    p = Rnd(100)
  Loop Until p <> me And p <> cst(K_BOSS)
  cst(K_X) = p : LookOf K_X, p
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- four weeks
Sub Season()
  Dim r As Integer, sc As Integer, best As Integer, b As Integer
  money = 100 : boss = 50 : rep = 20 : strikes = 0 : total = 0 : totalDone = 0 : pPal = 0
  hasApp = 0 : hanbok = 0 : flowers = 0 : energy = 100
  For k = 0 To NN - 1
    nRoom(k) = -1
  Next
  For day = 1 To DAYS
    r = OneDay()
    If r < 0 Then
      Morning
      Play Data.PO_SACKED, K_BOSS
      Play Data.PO_E_SACKED, K_YOU
      Final "SACKED"
      Exit Sub
    End If
  Next
  day = DAYS
  Morning
  Play Data.PO_LASTDAY, K_BOSS
  sc = 0
  If total > 0 Then sc = (totalDone * 100) \ total
  If sc >= 90 And boss >= 60 Then
    Play Data.PO_E_TOP, K_BOSS : txt = "POSTIE OF THE YEAR"
  ElseIf sc >= 70 Then
    Play Data.PO_E_GOOD, K_BOSS : txt = "A ROUND OF YOUR OWN"
  Else
    Play Data.PO_E_OK, K_BOSS : txt = "BACK TO SORTING"
  End If
  ' and love?
  best = 0
  For b = 1 To 99
    If aff(b) > aff(best) Then best = b
  Next
  Face.Hide 0
  If aff(best) >= 60 Then
    ThemIs best
    Play Data.PO_LOVE, K_THEM
    Play Data.PO_LOVE2, K_THEM
    If pick = 1 Then txt = txt & " + " & PNameOf(best)
  Else
    Play Data.PO_NOLOVE, K_YOU
  End If
  Final txt
End Sub

' at the Central Post Office, in front of the counter
Sub Morning()
  GoInside Town.POSTSHOP, 1, 160, 64, 1
  DrawAll
End Sub

' a day: 1 fine, 0 a bad day, -1 sacked
Function OneDay() As Integer
  Dim m0 As Integer, j As Integer
  mins = T_START : tickM = 0 : speedT = 0 : lookup = 0 : hungry = 0 : hitToday = 0
  energy = 100
  MakeBag
  Morning
  If day = 1 Then
    Play Data.PO_INTRO, K_BOSS
    Play Data.PO_INTRO2, K_X
  End If
  Play Data.PO_MORN01 + day - 1, K_BOSS
  Face.Hide 0
  TalkOff
  m0 = money
  BagScreen 1
  Round
  ' the day's done
  Spr.HideRange 0, 111
  Talk Data.TH_NIGHT, -1
  Morning
  total = total + nBag
  If nDone = nBag Then
    Play Data.PO_PRAISE, K_BOSS : boss = Clamp(boss + 5) : OneDay = 1
  ElseIf nDone * 2 >= nBag Then
    Play Data.PO_FINE, K_BOSS : OneDay = 1
  Else
    strikes = strikes + 1 : boss = Clamp(boss - 5) : OneDay = 0
    If strikes = 1 Then Play Data.PO_SCOLD, K_BOSS
    If strikes = 2 Then Play Data.PO_WARN, K_BOSS
    If strikes >= 3 Then OneDay = -1 : Exit Function
  End If
  If day Mod 5 = 0 Then
    Play Data.PO_PAYDAY, K_BOSS
    money = money + 500
  End If
  Face.Hide 0
  Results m0
End Function

' the day's sums
Sub Results(ByVal m0 As Integer)
  TalkOff
  Spr.HideRange 0, 111
  Board.Rect 0, 0, 40, 32, 0, 0
  Panel 6, 4, 28, 14
  Mid1 5, "DAY " & CStr(day) & " IS DONE", C_GOLD
  Board.Text 8, 7, "DELIVERED   " & CStr(nDone) & " OF " & CStr(nBag), C_WHITE
  Board.Text 8, 9, "MONEY TODAY " & Won(money - m0), C_MINT
  Board.Text 8, 10, "IN YOUR POCKET " & Won(money), C_MINT
  Board.Text 8, 12, "THE BOSS", C_WHITE : Bar 20, 12, 10, boss, 1
  Board.Text 8, 13, "THE TOWN", C_WHITE : Bar 20, 13, 10, rep, 0
  Board.Text 8, 15, "STRIKES: " & CStr(strikes) & " OF 3", C_PINK
  k = AnyKey()
End Sub

Sub Final(ByVal s As String)
  Face.Hide 0
  TalkOff
  Board.Rect 0, 0, 40, 32, 0, 0
  Panel 4, 5, 32, 14
  Mid1 7, s, C_GOLD
  Mid1 9, CStr(totalDone) & " OF " & CStr(total) & " DELIVERED", C_WHITE
  Mid1 11, "SAVED UP: " & Won(money), C_MINT
  Mid1 13, CStr(MetCount()) & " PEOPLE KNOW YOUR NAME", C_PINK
  Mid1 16, "SPACE", C_GREY
  k = AnyKey()
End Sub

Function MetCount() As Integer
  Dim c As Integer, p As Integer
  c = 0
  For p = 0 To 99
    If met(p) Then c = c + 1
  Next
  MetCount = c
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the bag
Sub MakeBag()
  Dim j As Integer, p As Integer, t As Integer, rad As Integer, r As Integer, s As Integer, ok As Integer
  nBag = 3 + (day * 9) \ 20
  If nBag > BAGMAX Then nBag = BAGMAX
  nDone = 0
  rad = 2 + day \ 2
  For j = 0 To nBag - 1
    bDone(j) = 0 : bFrom(j) = Rnd(16) : bKind(j) = (Rnd(5) < 2) And 1
    ok = 0
    If Rnd(4) = 0 Then
      ' a shop's post
      For t = 1 To 30
        r = Rnd(192)
        If Abs(r Mod 16 - 6) + Abs(r \ 16 - 4) <= rad Then
          LoadRoom r
          If rc(195) > 0 Then
            k = Rnd(rc(195))
            s = rc(197 + k * 4) + rc(198 + k * 4) * 256
            LoadShop s
            If sh(0) < Town.TY_APT And sh(0) <> Town.TY_POST And sh(0) <> Town.TY_MUSEUM Then
              bP(j) = -1 : bShop(j) = s : bFloor(j) = 1 : bUnit(j) = 0 : ok = 1 : Exit For
            End If
          End If
        End If
      Next
    End If
    If ok = 0 Then
      For t = 1 To 60
        p = Rnd(100)
        If Abs(HomeRoom(p) Mod 16 - 6) + Abs(HomeRoom(p) \ 16 - 4) <= rad Or t > 50 Then
          ok = 1
          For k = 0 To j - 1
            If bP(k) = p Then ok = 0
          Next
          If ok Then Exit For
        End If
      Next
      bP(j) = p : bShop(j) = HomeAt(p) : bFloor(j) = tb(2) : bUnit(j) = tb(3)
    End If
  Next
End Sub

' the bag: what's in it (full: the morning, with every address); Space the map, M back
Sub BagScreen(ByVal full As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer, y As Integer, c As Integer, v As Integer, a As String
  Spr.HideRange 0, 111
  Board.Rect 0, 0, 40, 32, 0, 0
  Panel 0, 0, 40, 32
  If full Then Mid1 1, "TODAY'S ROUND: LEARN THE ADDRESSES!", C_GOLD Else Mid1 1, "THE BAG - " & Clock(), C_GOLD
  For j = 0 To nBag - 1
    y = 3 + j * 2
    If bDone(j) Then c = C_DIM Else c = C_WHITE
    If bKind(j) Then a = "P " Else a = "L "
    If bP(j) >= 0 Then a = a & PNameOf(bP(j)) Else a = a & ShopName(bShop(j))
    LoadShop bShop(j)
    a = a & " - " & DistName(sh(4))
    If bDone(j) Then a = a & " (DONE)"
    Board.Text 2, y, Left$(a, 36), c
    If bDone(j) = 0 And bP(j) >= 0 Then
      If full Or lookup Then
        Board.Text 4, y + 1, Left$(Address(bShop(j), bFloor(j), bUnit(j)), 34), C_MINT
      Else
        Board.Text 4, y + 1, "...", C_DIM
      End If
    End If
  Next
  Board.Text 2, 28, "L LETTER (MAILBOX OK)  P PARCEL (DOOR)", C_GREY
  Board.Text 2, 30, "SPACE: THE MAP   M: BACK", C_GREY
  Do
    Tick
    v = Key()
  Loop Until v >= 5
  Board.Clear
  If v = 5 Then MapScreen
  Enter
End Sub

files.text:
' City - THE LITTLE SEOUL ENGINE: everything that is the city and not a game, for the ZX Spectrum
' Next in NTC BASIC. 192 screens of Seoul (its districts, landmarks, the Han and its bridges, the
' subway), shops and their insides, lifts and stairs, the hundred people at their addresses living
' their days, strangers, cars, talking (faces, the scene player), the map, hyperspace (T), and the
' frame loop that walks you round it all. The city's data is in the Next's other RAM (Data.cls,
' Town.cls, World.cls; tools/ makes it), its pictures in GfxData.cls (gfx/).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
'
' A NEW GAME: copy the engine, leave this file alone and write your own Game.bas (LITTLE SEOUL's,
' the postie game, is the example). The game owns the program's start (it calls CityStart first,
' then plays rounds of the city with Round) and its rules. docs/NEWGAME.md says it step by step.
'
' What this file calls in Game.bas - a game must have each of these (they may be empty):
'   Clockwork            once a frame, from Round: the game's clock (mins goes on), hunger ...
'   Hud                  the status line (after a talk, going in somewhere, a market stall)
'   Stat s, v / Feel v   a scene's !STAT and +N / -N lines (Play)
'   BagScreen 0          the M key, from Round (the postie's bag; its Space shows MapScreen)
'   Knock s, fl, u       a door: a house's (Door) or a flat's (Act)
'   Mailbox, Counter     Space on an apartment's mailboxes, on a shop's counter (Act)
'   AfterShop            after a shop's own scene (TalkTo, Counter)
'   BagFor, ItemWords, Delivered   the postie's bag - used on the lines marked ' GAME: here
' Lines marked ' GAME: below are a game's rules inside the city's routines (the postie's deliveries
' in TalkTo, the arrow to the next one, the bag on the map, money for the subway, a car knocking
' your energy): change or drop them for another game. Everything else is the city.
'
' What the city keeps that a game uses: day, mins (the clock: minutes from midnight), room / inShop /
' floor / px / py (where you are), stun, energy and speedT (how you walk), money (hundreds of won), cst / cLook (who's
' talking), aff / met (how the hundred feel about you), quit (Round ends when it is set).
Option Explicit

' text colours (tilemap palette rows)
Public Const C_WHITE = 0, C_GOLD = 1, C_PINK = 2, C_MINT = 3, C_GREY = 4, C_HI = 5, C_DIM = 6, C_BLACK = 7
' the cast: you, them (whoever you're talking to), the Postmaster, your colleague
Public Const K_YOU = 0, K_THEM = 1, K_BOSS = 2, K_X = 3
Public Const DAYS = 20, NN = 10, NCAR = 2
' the clock: minutes from midnight
Public Const T_END = 1080
' sprite slots
Public Const SP_YOU = 0, SP_NPC = 2, SP_NICON = 12, SP_KEEP = 22, SP_STALL = 23, SP_CAR = 27, SP_ARROW = 36, SP_MARK = 37
Public Const SL_FX = 111, NFX = 8

Public txt As String Max 80, pName As String Max 8, themName As String Max 12, lab0 As String Max 32, lab1 As String Max 32, lab2 As String Max 32
Public placeS As String Max 20, distS As String Max 16, itemS As String Max 8, tokT As String Max 16, tokH As String Max 20
' a person's record (fetched from Data when needed): 0 girl, 1 age, ... 8-16 the look, 24-31 the name
Public rec(31) As Byte, recOf As Integer, broke As Integer, hatV As Integer, slotWas As Integer, schedPg As Integer
' the scene being played, a line of it, a directory entry, a word from a table
Public sb(447) As Byte, lb(63) As Byte, de8(7) As Byte, tb(23) As Byte
' the cast's faces (9 bytes each), who they are (-1: nobody in particular), how the town feels
Public cLook(35) As Byte, cst(3) As Integer, aff(99) As Byte, met(99) As Byte
Public themP As Integer
' the city: this room's record, a shop's, a type's; block attributes and map colours

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- as a CyborgOS task (docs/TASK.md)
#If NTC_ZXN Then
#Else
' The city's data: LSCITY.DAT (tools/cosnext.sh makes it), next to LSGAME.CYB - Nx.LoadCity has
' the details
' TaskStart: the console's screen registers noted (Nx.ConSave), the data loaded (Nx.LoadCity: the store taken, LSCITY.DAT read into it, the page table at
' #BF00 - a data page as the NEX has it -> the 8K page it is in now), the task's own page in slot 7
' noted, bank 5's first page in slot 6; then it waits to be in front (RUN 7 LSGAME, then Caps
' Shift + 7) - a game draws only while it's in front
Sub TaskStart()
  Dim r As Integer
  Print "LITTLE SEOUL: loading the city ..."
  r = Nx.LoadCity()                             ' (first: it asks CyborgOS which machine this is before
  If r = 6 Then Print "For the ZX Spectrum Next" : End   ' any port is touched - on a CPC #243B is the PPI)
  If r = 1 Then Print "Not enough free memory" : End
  If r = 2 Then Print "The store's pages not found" : End
  If r = 3 Then Print "LSCITY.DAT not found" : End
  If r = 4 Then Print "LSCITY.DAT too short, or not the city" : End
  If r = 5 Then Print "No three 16K pages in a row for Layer 2" : End
  Nx.Snap                                       ' (the console's screen registers, before the game
  Nx.ConSave                                    ' has touched them: put back whenever it's away)
  Nx.TaskInit
  Print "LITTLE SEOUL: ready - Caps Shift + its slot's number to play"
  Do
    Nx.Yield
  Loop Until Nx.Front()
End Sub

#End If

  b = GfxData.T_BARP
  If mint Then b = GfxData.T_BARM
  For t = 0 To w - 1

Function Key() As Integer
  Dim j As Integer, v As Integer, f2 As Integer
  j = Keys.Joystick(0)
  v = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or (j And Keys.JoyUp) Then v = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or (j And Keys.JoyDown) Then v = 2
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or (j And Keys.JoyLeft) Then v = 3
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or (j And Keys.JoyRight) Then v = 4
  f2 = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeySpace) Or (j And Keys.JoyFire1) Then f2 = 5
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyM) Or (j And Keys.JoyFire2) Then f2 = 6
  If f2 Then
    If firWas = 0 Then firWas = f2 : Key = f2 : Exit Function
    Key = 0 : Exit Function
  End If
  firWas = 0
  If v = 0 Then keyT = 0 : Key = 0 : Exit Function
  If keyT = 0 Then
    keyT = 14 : Key = v
  Else
    keyT = keyT - 1
    If keyT = 0 Then keyT = 6 : Key = v Else Key = 0
  End If
End Function

' MakeLook sd, kind: a nameless person's look (cLook(9-17), them's) from seed sd; an ajumma wears a
' sun visor (hatV: Face.Put's hat 2), as her sprite does
Sub MakeLook(ByVal sd As Integer, ByVal kind As Integer)
  Dim girl As Integer, q As Integer
  hatV = (kind = 3) And 2
  girl = (kind = 2 Or kind = 3)
  ' part k: (s \ divisor) mod how many (01 03 05 07 11 13 17 19 / 2 3 7 4 6 3 6 1 7), s = Abs(sd * 37 + 11)
  For q = 0 To 8
    cLook(9 + q) = Part(sd, Val(Mid$("010305071113171719", q * 2 + 1, 2)), Val(Mid$("237463617", q + 1, 1)))
  Next
  If girl Then cLook(11) = Part(sd, 5, 8) Else cLook(11) = cLook(11) + 8
  cLook(13) = cLook(13) + 2
  If girl Then cLook(13) = Part(sd, 11, 2)
  If kind >= 3 Then cLook(12) = 6
  If kind = 4 Then cLook(16) = 6
End Sub

' Part(sd, d, m): ((Abs(sd * 37 + 11)) \ d) Mod m - a face part from a seed, in 24 bits (sd * 37 is
' past an Integer for most seeds, and NTC's Long arithmetic is 900 bytes of library)
Function Part(ByVal sd As Integer, ByVal d As Integer, ByVal m As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; DE = sd
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (pt_d + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (pt_m + 1), a
            xor a
            bit 7, d
            jr z, pt_p
            ld a, e                 ; sd < 0: Abs(sd * 37 + 11) = -sd * 37 - 11
            cpl
            ld e, a
            ld a, d
            cpl
            ld d, a
            inc de
            ld a, 1
pt_p:
            ld (pt_n + 1), a
            ld h, d
            ld l, e
            ld c, 0                 ; C:HL = sd, then * 8 + sd, * 4 + sd (= * 37)
            add hl, hl
            rl c
            add hl, hl
            rl c
            add hl, hl
            rl c
            add hl, de
            ld a, c
            adc a, 0
            add hl, hl
            rla
            add hl, hl
            rla
            add hl, de
            adc a, 0
            ld de, 11
pt_n:
            ld b, 0
            inc b
            dec b
            jr nz, pt_sub
            add hl, de              ; + 11
            adc a, 0
            jr pt_ok
pt_sub:
            and a                   ; - 11
            sbc hl, de
            sbc a, 0
pt_ok:
            ld e, a                 ; E:HL = s
pt_d:
            ld c, 0
            ld b, 24
            xor a
pt_l1:
            add hl, hl              ; E:HL / C: the quotient in E:HL
            rl e
            rla
            cp c
            jr c, pt_s1
            sub c
            inc l
pt_s1:
            djnz pt_l1
pt_m:
            ld c, 0
            ld b, 24
            xor a
pt_l2:
            add hl, hl              ; E:HL mod C: the remainder in A
            rl e
            rla
            cp c
            jr c, pt_s2
            sub c
pt_s2:
            djnz pt_l2
            pop hl
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

  Select Case b
    Case 1
      TokName = pName
    Case 2
      TokName = CName(K_THEM)
    Case 3
      TokName = CName(K_X)
    Case 4
      TokName = placeS
    Case 5
      TokName = CName(K_BOSS)
    Case 6
      TokName = distS
    Case 7
      TokName = itemS
    Case 11
      TokName = tokT
    Case Else
      TokName = tokH
  End Select
End Function

Function CName(ByVal c As Integer) As String
  If c < 0 Then

  ElseIf c = K_YOU Then

  ElseIf cst(c) < 0 Then

  Else
    CName = PNameOf(cst(c))
  End If

Sub Play(ByVal id As Integer, ByVal a As Integer)
  Dim pc As Integer, op As Integer, ln As Integer, src As Integer, v As Integer, nopt As Integer, c As Integer, t As Integer
  TalkOn
  spk = a : pick = 0 : mood = -1
  ' whoever you're with is there from the start (a scene can open with the narrator)
  If a = K_THEM And faceOn <> K_THEM Then ShowFace K_THEM, -1
  ln = id * 5
  Data.Copy Data.DIRPAGE + ln \ 8192, ln And 8191, 5, VarPtr(de8)
  ln = de8(3) + de8(4) * 256
  If ln = 0 Then Exit Sub
  Data.Copy de8(0), de8(1) + de8(2) * 256, ln, VarPtr(sb)
  If faceOn <> spk Then ShowFace spk, -1
  pc = 0
  Do
    op = sb(pc)
    Select Case op
      Case Data.OP_END
        Exit Do
      Case Data.OP_SAY, Data.OP_NARR
        If op = Data.OP_SAY And spk >= 0 Then
          TextBox CName(spk) : c = C_WHITE
        Else
          TextBox "" : c = C_MINT
        End If
        src = VarPtr(sb) + pc + 1
        fast = 0 : t = 0
        Do
          src = Data.Expand(src, VarPtr(lb))
          PrintLB 24 + t, c
          t = t + 1
        Loop Until Data.Term() = 0
        pc = src - VarPtr(sb)
        WaitGo
      Case Data.OP_WHO
        v = sb(pc + 1)
        spk = -1
        If v < 4 Then spk = v            ' K_YOU, K_THEM, K_BOSS, K_X
        If faceOn <> spk Then ShowFace spk, -1
        pc = pc + 2
      Case Data.OP_MOOD
        mood = sb(pc + 1)
        If spk >= 0 Then ShowFace spk, mood
        pc = pc + 2
      Case Data.OP_ICON
        Burst sb(pc + 1)
        If sb(pc + 1) = 9 Then
          Sfx.Play 1, 300, 20, 12, 20, 0
        Else
          Sfx.Play 1, 80, -3, 12, 12, 0
        End If
        pc = pc + 2
      Case Data.OP_AFF
        v = SByte(pc + 1)
        Feel v   ' GAME:
        If themP >= 0 Then
          If v > 0 Then Fx 200, 120, 0 Else Fx 200, 120, 9
        End If
        pc = pc + 2
      Case Data.OP_STAT
        Stat sb(pc + 1), SByte(pc + 2)   ' GAME:
        pc = pc + 3
      Case Data.OP_FLAG
        pc = pc + 2
      Case Data.OP_MONEY
        v = SByte(pc + 1)
        If money + v * 10 < 0 Then broke = 1 : Exit Do   ' GAME:
        money = money + v * 10   ' GAME:
        If v < 0 Then Kerching
        pc = pc + 3
      Case Data.OP_CHOICE
        nopt = sb(pc + 1)
        src = VarPtr(sb) + pc + 2
        For t = 0 To nopt - 1
          src = Data.Expand(src, VarPtr(lb))
          txt = LBStr()
          If t = 0 Then lab0 = txt
          If t = 1 Then lab1 = txt
          If t = 2 Then lab2 = txt
        Next
        pc = src - VarPtr(sb)
        c = Choose(nopt)
        pick = c + 1
        pc = sb(pc + c * 2) + sb(pc + c * 2 + 1) * 256
      Case Data.OP_GOTO
        pc = sb(pc + 1) + sb(pc + 2) * 256
      Case Else
        Exit Do
    End Select
  Loop
  Board.Rect 0, 22, 40, 10, 0, 0
End Sub

' the ones due here now: in this shop, sitting down (walk: coming in at the door), or in the first
' ten minutes of a half hour, on their way to a door in this street; how many came
Function Gather(ByVal walk As Integer) As Integer
  Dim p As Integer, d As Integer, t As Integer, j As Integer, c As Integer
  Gather = 0
  For p = 0 To 99
    d = WhereAt(p, mins)
    t = -1
    If inShop < 0 Then
      If (mins Mod 30) < 10 And d <> WhereAt(p, mins - 30) Then t = DoorOf(d)
    ElseIf d = inShop And HomeAt(p) <> inShop Then
      t = 0
    End If
    If t >= 0 And Seen(p, HereKey()) = 0 Then
      j = NewNpc()
      If j < 0 Then Exit Function
      If inShop < 0 Then
        StreetNpc j, 1, t
      Else
        Sit j
        If walk Then npx(j) = 112 : npy(j) = 176 : nst(j) = 5
      End If
      If nRoom(j) <> -1 Then SetWho j, p : Gather = Gather + 1
    End If
  Next
End Function

            c = Seat()
            ntx(j) = (c Mod 16) * 16 : nty(j) = (c \ 16) * 16 - 3 : nst(j) = 5
          Else
            ntx(j) = 112 : nty(j) = 176 : nst(j) = 7
            If nRoom(j) = -5 Then ntm(j) = 30000 : nst(j) = 6
          End If
        End If
      Else
        StepNpc j
        If npx(j) = ntx(j) And npy(j) = nty(j) Then ArriveNpc j
      End If
    End If
  Next
  ' sometimes someone new walks in from the side
  If inShop < 0 And (frames And 255) = 0 Then
    j = NewNpc()
    If j >= 0 Then StreetNpc j, 0, -1
  End If
  ' the half hour turns: the ones due here come
  c = day * 64 + mins \ 30
  If c <> slotWas Then
    slotWas = c
    For j = 0 To NN - 1
      If nwho(j) >= 0 Then ntm(j) = 1      ' (the hundred here look at their day again)
    Next
    If inShop < 0 Or (floor <= 1 And rc(198) < 255) Then c = Gather(1)
  End If
End Sub

Sub ArriveNpc(ByVal j As Integer)
  Dim s As Integer, c As Integer
  Select Case nst(j)
    Case 1
      ' off the side: on into the next street (they're still there if you follow)
      nRoom(j) = -1
      If npx(j) < 0 And room Mod 16 > 0 Then nRoom(j) = room - 1 : npx(j) = 256
      If npx(j) > 240 And room Mod 16 < 15 Then nRoom(j) = room + 1 : npx(j) = -16
    Case 2
      ' in through the door: they're inside now (you can follow them)
      c = nicon(j)
      s = rc(197 + c * 4) + rc(198 + c * 4) * 256
      nicon(j) = 255
      LoadShop s
      LoadType sh(0)
      If ty(0) = 255 Then
        nRoom(j) = -1
      Else
        nRoom(j) = 256 + s : nst(j) = 10 : ntm(j) = 10 + Rnd(30)
      End If
    Case 3, 5
      If nst(j) = 3 Then nst(j) = 4 : ntm(j) = 100 + Rnd(150) Else nst(j) = 6 : ntm(j) = 200 + Rnd(300)
      ndir(j) = 1
      nicon(j) = 2
      If sType = Town.TY_CAFE Then nicon(j) = 7
      If sType = Town.TY_NOODLE Or sType = Town.TY_BBQ Or sType = Town.TY_CHICKEN Then nicon(j) = 8
      If sType = Town.TY_NORAE Then nicon(j) = 11
      If nst(j) = 6 Then nicon(j) = 13
    Case 7
      ' out of the door: onto the street
      nicon(j) = 255
      LeaveShop j
  End Select
End Sub

  Dim s As Integer
  s = nRoom(j) - 256

  npx(j) = (sh(6) Mod 16) * 16 : npy(j) = (sh(6) \ 16) * 16 + 13

End Sub

  If px > npx(j) + 8 Then ndir(j) = 2

' some letters of a table's record as a string (trailing spaces off)
Function TabStr(ByVal page As Integer, ByVal off As Integer, ByVal w As Integer) As String
  Dim s As String, c As Integer
  Data.Copy page, off, w, VarPtr(tb)
  s = ""
  For c = 0 To w - 1
    s = s & Chr$(tb(c))
  Next
  TabStr = RTrim$(s)

' a shop's name: CHERRY CAFE, HANBIT APT 104, N SEOUL TOWER...
Function ShopName(ByVal s As Integer) As String
  Dim t As Integer, w As String
  LoadShop s
  t = sh(0)
  If sh(2) >= 128 Then
    ShopName = TabStr(Data.W_NAMES, (sh(2) - 128) * 20, 20)
    Exit Function
  End If
  w = TabStr(Data.W_WORDS, sh(2) * 8, 8)
  LoadShop s
  If t = Town.TY_APT Then
    ShopName = w & " APT " & CStr(100 + sh(3))
  ElseIf t = Town.TY_HOUSE Then
    ShopName = "HOUSE NO. " & CStr(sh(3))
  ElseIf t = Town.TY_OFFICE Then
    ShopName = w & " TOWER"
  Else
    ShopName = w & " " & TabStr(Data.W_TYPES, (t) * 64 + 16, 16)
  End If
End Function

        End If
        If Len(t) > w * 2 Then t = Left$(t, w * 2)
        x = 4 + (rc(199 + j * 4) And 15) * 2 + (w * 2 - Len(t)) \ 2
        y = 4 + (c \ 16 - 1) * 2 + 1
        Board.Text x, y, t, C_WHITE
      End If
    Next
  Else
    For j = 0 To 3
      c = rc(203 + j)
      If c < 255 Then Board.Text 3 + (c Mod 16) * 2, 5, CStr(floor * 100 + j + 1), C_GOLD
    Next
  End If
End Sub

Function Clock() As String
  Clock = Right$("0" & CStr(mins \ 60), 2) & ":" & Right$("0" & CStr(mins Mod 60), 2)
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the map of blocks
Function CellAt(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; BC: x
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; DE: y
            ld a, b
            or d
            jr nz, ca_no            ; off the screen (below 0, or over 255)
            ld a, e
            cp 192
            jr nc, ca_no
            and #F0
            ld e, a
            ld a, c
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            and #0F
            or e
            ld e, a                 ; (y \ 16) * 16 + x \ 16
            jr ca_out
ca_no:
            ld de, -1
ca_out:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

Function AttrAt(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
  Dim c As Integer
  c = CellAt(x, y)
  If c < 0 Then AttrAt = 0 Else AttrAt = battr(rc(c))
End Function

' can your feet (a box at the bottom of a 16 x 16 sprite at x, y) stand there?
' Free(x, y): you can stand at x, y - none of the feet's four corners on a solid block
Function Free(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld (fr_x + 1), de
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld (fr_y + 1), de
            ld hl, fr_off           ; the feet's four corners
            ld b, 4
fr_lp:
            ld (fr_p + 1), hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (fr_dy + 1), a
fr_x:
            ld hl, 0
            ld e, c
            ld d, 0
            add hl, de
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr nz, fr_nx            ; off the screen: nothing in the way
            ld c, l
fr_y:
            ld hl, 0
fr_dy:
            ld e, 0
            add hl, de
            ld a, h
            or a
            jr nz, fr_nx
            ld a, l
            cp 192
            jr nc, fr_nx
            and #F0
            ld l, a
            ld a, c
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            rrca
            and #0F
            or l                    ; the cell
            ld e, a
            ld hl, {rc}
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            ld hl, {battr}
            add hl, de
            bit 0, (hl)             ; Town.A_SOLID
            jr nz, fr_no
fr_nx:
fr_p:
            ld hl, 0
            inc hl
            inc hl
            djnz fr_lp
            ld a, 1
            jr fr_out
fr_no:
            xor a
fr_out:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            jr fr_end
fr_off:     db 3, 11, 12, 11, 3, 15, 12, 15
fr_end:
#endasm
End Function

' the block in front of you (a cell number, or -1)
Function Facing() As Integer
  Dim x As Integer, y As Integer
  x = px + 8 : y = py + 12
  If pdir = 0 Then y = y + 12
  If pdir = 1 Then y = y - 12
  If pdir = 2 Then x = x + 12
  If pdir = 3 Then x = x - 12
  Facing = CellAt(x, y)
End Function

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the round: a day's walking
Sub Round()
  Dim v As Integer
  quit = 0
  Do
    Tick
    Clockwork   ' GAME:
    If stun > 0 Then
      stun = stun - 1
    Else
      Walk
    End If
    People
    If rc(194) And 1 Then Cars
    DrawAll
    v = Key()
    If v = 5 And stun = 0 Then Act
    If v = 6 Then BagScreen 0   ' GAME:
    If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyT) And stun = 0 Then Hyper
    If mins >= T_END Then quit = 1   ' GAME:
  Loop Until quit
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- walking
Sub Walk()
  Dim j As Integer, mx As Integer, my As Integer, sp As Integer, a As Integer, nx2 As Integer, ny2 As Integer
  j = Keys.Joystick(0)
  mx = 0 : my = 0
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyO) Or (j And Keys.JoyLeft) Then mx = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyP) Or (j And Keys.JoyRight) Then mx = 1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyQ) Or (j And Keys.JoyUp) Then my = -1
  If Keys.Down(Keys.KeyA) Or (j And Keys.JoyDown) Then my = 1
  If mx = 0 And my = 0 Then pstep = 0 : Exit Sub
  If mx < 0 Then pdir = 3
  If mx > 0 Then pdir = 2
  If my < 0 Then pdir = 1
  If my > 0 Then pdir = 0
  sp = 2
  If speedT > 0 Then sp = 3   ' GAME:
  If energy < 10 Then sp = 1   ' GAME:
  pstep = pstep + 1
  a = Free(px, py) = 0                            ' stuck in something (a car threw you there): walk out
  nx2 = px + mx * sp
  If a Or Free(nx2, py) Then px = nx2
  ny2 = py + my * sp
  If a Or Free(px, ny2) Then py = ny2
  ' off the edge: the next street
  If rc(192) = 0 Then
    If px < -6 Then Flip -1, 0 : Exit Sub
    If px > 246 Then Flip 1, 0 : Exit Sub
    If py < -10 Then Flip 0, -1 : Exit Sub
    If py > 180 Then Flip 0, 1 : Exit Sub
  Else
    If px < 0 Then px = 0
    If px > 240 Then px = 240
    If py < 0 Then py = 0
  End If
  ' walked into a door, the stairs down, the way out
  a = AttrAt(px + 8, py + 12)
  If a And (Town.A_DOOR Or Town.A_STAIRS) Then Door CellAt(px + 8, py + 12)
End Sub

' the next street over (dx, dy), if there is one and you can stand where you'd be
Sub Flip(ByVal dx As Integer, ByVal dy As Integer)
  Dim x As Integer, y As Integer, r As Integer, ox As Integer, oy As Integer, orr As Integer
  x = room Mod 16 + dx : y = room \ 16 + dy
  ox = px : oy = py
  If x < 0 Or x > 15 Or y < 0 Or y > 11 Then Unflip : Exit Sub
  r = y * 16 + x
  If dx < 0 Then px = 240
  If dx > 0 Then px = 0
  If dy < 0 Then py = 176
  If dy > 0 Then py = -4
  orr = room
  LoadRoom r
  If Free(px, py) = 0 Then
    LoadRoom orr
    px = ox : py = oy
    Unflip
    Exit Sub
  End If
  GoStreet r, px, py, pdir
End Sub

' the edge of town (or a wall): back a step
Sub Unflip()
  If px < 0 Then px = 0
  If px > 240 Then px = 240
  If py < -4 Then py = -4
  If py > 176 Then py = 176
End Sub

' a door at cell c: the street's doors (shops, houses, the subway) and the inside's way out
Sub Door(ByVal c As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer, s As Integer
  If rc(192) Then
    ' the way out (only on the ground floor)
    If doorCell >= 176 Then
      GoStreet streetRoom, (doorCell Mod 16) * 16, 156, 1
    Else
      GoStreet streetRoom, (doorCell Mod 16) * 16, (doorCell \ 16) * 16 + 16, 0
    End If
    Exit Sub
  End If
  s = -1
  For j = 0 To rc(195) - 1
    If rc(196 + j * 4) = c Then s = rc(197 + j * 4) + rc(198 + j * 4) * 256
  Next
  If s < 0 Then py = py + 4 : Exit Sub
  LoadShop s
  If sh(0) = Town.TY_HOUSE Then
    py = (c \ 16) * 16 + 16 : pdir = 1
    Knock s, 1, 1   ' GAME:
    Exit Sub
  End If
  Sfx.Play 0, 200, -6, 10, 8, 0
  GoInside s, 1, 112, 160, 1
  If sh(0) = Town.TY_APT Then
    If BagFor(s, -1) >= 0 And Rnd(2) = 0 Then   ' GAME:
      ThemNobody "GUARD", s, 4
      Talk Data.SH_LOBBY, K_THEM
    End If
  End If
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- Space: whatever's in front of you
Sub Act()
  Dim c As Integer, a As Integer, b As Integer, j As Integer
  ' someone to talk to?
  j = NearNpc()
  If j >= 0 Then TalkTo j : Exit Sub
  c = Facing()
  If c < 0 Then Exit Sub
  b = rc(c) : a = battr(b)
  If rc(192) = 0 Then
    If b = Town.B_MARKET_AWN Then Stall : Exit Sub
    If b = Town.B_VENDING Then Talk Data.TH_VENDING, -1 : Exit Sub
    If b = Town.B_POSTBOX Then Talk Data.TH_POSTBOX, -1 : Exit Sub
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If b = Town.B_MAILBOXES Then Mailbox : Exit Sub   ' GAME:
  If b = Town.B_TICKETS Then Subway : Exit Sub
  If b = Town.B_BINOCS Then Talk Data.TH_BINOCS, -1 : Exit Sub
  If b = Town.B_EXHIBIT Then Talk Data.TH_EXHIBIT, -1 : Exit Sub
  If b = Town.B_APTDOOR Then
    For j = 0 To 3
      If rc(203 + j) = c Then Knock inShop, floor, j + 1   ' GAME:
    Next
    Exit Sub
  End If
  If a And Town.A_LIFT Then Lift : Exit Sub
  If a And Town.A_COUNTER Then Counter : Exit Sub   ' GAME:
End Sub

' a market stall outside
Sub Stall()
  ThemNobody "AJUMMA", room * 3 + px \ 16, 3
  If distS = "NORYANGJIN" Then Talk Data.SH_STALL, K_THEM Else Talk Data.SH_MARKET, K_THEM
  Hud   ' GAME:
End Sub

' the lift (or the stairs): a floor
Sub Lift()
  Dim v As Integer, fl As Integer
  If floors <= 1 Then Exit Sub
  fl = floor
  Panel 12, 8, 16, 7
  Board.Text 14, 9, "WHICH FLOOR?", C_GOLD
  Board.Text 14, 13, "Q A  SPACE", C_GREY
  Do
    Board.Rect 14, 11, 12, 1, GfxData.T_BOX, 0
    Board.Text 17, 11, "< " & CStr(fl) & "F >", C_HI
    v = NextKey()
    If (v = 1 Or v = 4) And fl < floors Then fl = fl + 1 : Blip
    If (v = 2 Or v = 3) And fl > 1 Then fl = fl - 1 : Blip
  Loop Until v >= 5
  Board.Rect 12, 8, 16, 7, 0, 0
  If v = 6 Or fl = floor Then RoomText : Exit Sub
  ' the ride (a minute; the stairs a minute a floor)
  If rc(rc(202)) = Town.B_STAIRS_UP Then
    mins = mins + Abs(fl - floor)
    energy = Clamp(energy - Abs(fl - floor))   ' GAME:
    If Rnd(4) = 0 Then Talk Data.TH_STAIRS, K_YOU
  Else
    mins = mins + 1
    If Rnd(6) = 0 Then Talk Data.TH_LIFT, K_YOU
    Ding
  End If
  GoInside inShop, fl, (rc(202) Mod 16) * 16, 32, 0
End Sub

' ---------------------------------------------------------------- the subway
Sub Subway()
  Dim v As Integer, sel As Integer, j As Integer, here As Integer, x As Integer, y As Integer, s As Integer, d As Integer
  here = -1
  For j = 0 To Town.NSTATION - 1
    Data.Copy Data.W_STATIONS, j * 32, 4, VarPtr(tb)
    If tb(0) + tb(1) * 256 = inShop Then here = j
  Next
  Blank
  L2.Rect 0, 0, 256, 192, 0
  Board.Text 2, 0, "THE SUBWAY: WHERE TO? W1,400", C_GOLD
  For j = 0 To Town.NSTATION - 1
    Board.Text 4, j + 1, TabStr(Data.W_STATIONS, j * 32 + 16, 16), C_WHITE
    Board.Text 22, j + 1, "LINE " & TabStr(Data.W_STATIONS, j * 32 + 4, 6), C_MINT
  Next
  sel = here
  If sel < 0 Then sel = 0
  Do
    Board.Text 2, sel + 1, ">", C_PINK
    v = NextKey()
    Board.Text 2, sel + 1, " ", C_PINK
    If v = 1 And sel > 0 Then sel = sel - 1 : Blip
    If v = 2 And sel < Town.NSTATION - 1 Then sel = sel + 1 : Blip
  Loop Until v >= 5
  Board.Clear
  If v = 6 Or sel = here Then Enter : Exit Sub
  If money < 14 Then Talk Data.TH_NOMONEY, K_YOU : Enter : Exit Sub   ' GAME:
  money = money - 14   ' GAME:
  Data.Copy Data.W_STATIONS, sel * 32, 4, VarPtr(tb)
  s = tb(0) + tb(1) * 256
  LoadShop inShop
  x = sh(5)
  LoadShop s
  d = Abs(sh(5) Mod 16 - x Mod 16) + Abs(sh(5) \ 16 - x \ 16)
  mins = mins + 4 + d * 2
  placeS = TabStr(Data.W_STATIONS, sel * 32 + 16, 16)
  If Rnd(3) = 0 Then
    ThemNobody "", 0, 1
    Talk Data.TH_TRAIN, -1
  End If
  Sfx.Play 0, 90, 1, 12, 30, 0
  GoInside s, 1, 112, 48, 0
End Sub

' the map of the whole town: a dot a block; Q A O P look round
Sub MapScreen()
  Dim r As Integer, v As Integer, mx As Integer, my As Integer, d As Integer, j As Integer, sx As Integer
  Board.Clear
  Spr.HideRange 0, 128
  L2.Rect 0, 0, 256, 192, 0
  Data.Copy Data.W_MINI, 0, 256, VarPtr(sb)
  For r = 0 To 191
    LoadRoom r
    World.Mini VarPtr(rc), VarPtr(sb), (r Mod 16) * 16, 24 + (r \ 16) * 12
  Next
  Board.Text 4, 2, "SEOUL", C_GOLD
  Board.Text 4, 25, "Q A O P: LOOK ROUND   M: BACK", C_GREY
  If inShop >= 0 Then r = streetRoom Else r = room
  mx = r Mod 16 : my = r \ 16 : d = -1
  ' the bag's districts
  For j = 0 To nBag - 1   ' GAME:
    If bDone(j) = 0 Then   ' GAME:
      LoadShop bShop(j)   ' GAME:
      Data.Copy Data.W_DISTRICTS, sh(4) * 32 + 17, 4, VarPtr(tb)
      sx = tb(0) * 16 + tb(2) * 8 - 8
      If lookup Then sx = (sh(5) Mod 16) * 16 : tb(1) = sh(5) \ 16 : tb(3) = 0   ' GAME:
      Spr.Put 40 + j, sx + 32, 24 + tb(1) * 12 + tb(3) * 6 - 6 + 32, GfxData.S_ICON + bKind(j), Spr.Pal * 15   ' GAME:
    End If
  Next
  Do
    Spr.Put SP_MARK, (r Mod 16) * 16 + 32, 24 + (r \ 16) * 12 + 30, GfxData.S_ICON2, Spr.Pal * 15
    Spr.Put SP_MARK + 1, mx * 16 + 32, 24 + my * 12 + 30, GfxData.S_ICON + 9, (Spr.Pal * 15) Or Spr.MirrorY
    LoadRoom my * 16 + mx
    If rc(193) <> d Then
      d = rc(193)
      Board.Rect 12, 2, 26, 1, 0, 0
      Board.Text 12, 2, DistName(d), C_WHITE
    End If
    v = NextKey()
    mx = Step4(v, mx, 3, 4, 15) : my = Step4(v, my, 1, 2, 11)
  Loop Until v >= 5
  Spr.HideRange 0, 128
  Board.Clear
  LoadRoom room
End Sub
