' Nx - the ZX Spectrum Next's own hardware, straight on the ports: NextRegs (#243B select,
' #253B value), the layer order, the border, palettes, the CPU speed.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' No Z80N opcodes are used (plain out (c)), so any Z80 assembler builds it.
Option Explicit

' layer orders (NextReg #15 bits 4-2): first = on top. S sprites, L Layer 2, U ULA + tilemap
Public Const OrderSLU = 0
Public Const OrderLSU = 1
Public Const OrderSUL = 2
Public Const OrderLUS = 3
Public Const OrderUSL = 4
Public Const OrderULS = 5
' palettes for PalEntry / PalTable (NextReg #43 bits 6-4, the first of each pair)
Public Const PalULA = 0
Public Const PalLayer2 = 1
Public Const PalSprites = 2
Public Const PalTiles = 3

' Reg r, v: NextReg r = v
Public Sub Reg(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
#endasm
End Sub

' RegGet(r): NextReg r read back
Public Function RegGet(ByVal r As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Layers order: which layer is on top (OrderSLU ...), sprites on and over the border kept
Public Sub Layers(ByVal order As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            add a, a
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #15
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            and %11100011
            or e
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Border c: the border colour (0-7, port #FE)
Public Sub Border(ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 7
            out (#FE), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalEntry which, index, colour: one colour (RRRGGGBB) of a palette (PalULA ... PalTiles, the
' first palette of each)
Public Sub PalEntry(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal index As Integer, ByVal colour As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a                 ; palette select, bits 6-4
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; index
            pop hl
            ld l, (hl)              ; colour
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), l
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' PalTable which, first, count, address: count colours (1 byte each, RRRGGGBB) from memory
Public Sub PalTable(ByVal which As Integer, ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer, ByVal address As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 3
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; count (1-256: 0 = 256)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
pt_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, pt_lp
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Raster(): the line the display is on now (0-311; 0-191 the picture)
Public Function Raster() As Integer
#asm
            ld bc, #243B
rs_again:
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in d, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1F
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in e, (c)
            dec b
            ld a, #1E
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            cp d
            jr nz, rs_again
            and 1
            ld d, a
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

' Seed n: start Rnd's sequence from n (as Randomize n - kept here because Randomize with a
' variable doesn't link on its own in this NTC build: kw_seedv jumps into kw_seedl's section)
Public Sub Seed(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld h, (hl)
            ld l, a
            or h
            jr nz, sd_ok
            inc l
sd_ok:
            ld (ntc_rnd_seed), hl
#endasm
End Sub

' ---- as a CyborgOS task (not the NEX: docs/TASK.md)
' WaitFrame: wait for the next frame (the display passing line 200), handing the CPU to the
' hypervisor (Yield) while waiting - a task has no frame interrupt of its own. Then bank 5's
' first page (the tilemap) back in slot 6: the hypervisor's switch puts the task's own pages in.
' The hypervisor only ever has the CPU inside a Yield (a task in turbo mode isn't stopped), so
' the screen's registers are noted first (Snap). After each Yield the game asks whether it is
' still in front (Front): if another slot has come to the front (Caps Shift + 1, TOP ...), the
' console's screen registers go back as they were before the game started (ConIn, Back, ConOut:
' TaskInit noted them) - CyborgOS has drawn its console into bank 5's second page, which the
' console's registers show - and the game waits here, its hands off the screen, until it is in
' front again; then its own registers go back (Back) and it carries on at whatever screen it was
' at. Its pictures were never touched
Public Sub WaitFrame()
  Dim l As Integer, was As Integer
  Snap
  was = Raster()
  Do
    Yield
    If Front() = 0 Then
      ConIn
      Back
      ConOut
      Do
        Yield
      Loop Until Front()
      Back
      Exit Do
    End If
    l = Raster()
    If l >= 200 And was < 200 Then Exit Do
    was = l
  Loop
  Reg &H56, 10
End Sub

' ConSave: (TaskInit, before the game touches the screen) the console's registers noted (Snap's,
' kept in cn_vals). ConIn: the game's noted ones put aside and the console's in their place, for
' Back. ConOut: the game's back in place
Public Sub ConSave()
#asm
    IFNDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld hl, sn_vals
            ld de, cn_vals
            ld bc, 25              ; (sn_vals, sn_pals, sn_l2)
            ldir
            jr cs_end
@cn_vals:   ds 25
@cn_tmp:    ds 25
cs_end:
    ENDIF
#endasm
End Sub

Public Sub ConIn()
#asm
    IFNDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld hl, sn_vals
            ld de, cn_tmp
            ld bc, 25              ; (sn_vals, sn_pals, sn_l2)
            ldir
            ld hl, cn_vals
            ld de, sn_vals
            ld bc, 25              ; (sn_vals, sn_pals, sn_l2)
            ldir
    ENDIF
#endasm
End Sub

Public Sub ConOut()
#asm
    IFNDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld hl, cn_tmp
            ld de, sn_vals
            ld bc, 25              ; (sn_vals, sn_pals, sn_l2)
            ldir
    ENDIF
#endasm
End Sub

' Snap: the screen registers that the game and CyborgOS's console both set noted as they are now -
' the tilemap's, the layers', the transparency, the palette control and the tilemap's first two
' colours (the console's text colours), Layer 2's bank, mode and scroll (#12, #70, #16, #17, #71)
' and its port #123B. Back: them put back
Public Sub Snap()
#asm
    IFNDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld hl, sn_regs
            ld de, sn_vals
            ld bc, #243B
sn_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, sn_pal
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            dec b
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            jr sn_lp
sn_pal:
            ld a, #43               ; the tilemap's first palette, for reading
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (sn_vals)
            and #0F
            or #30
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld hl, sn_pals
            xor a                   ; colours 0 and 1: #41 (RRRGGGBB) and #44 (its 9th bit)
sn_pl:
            ld e, a
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            dec b
            ld a, #41
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            dec b
            ld a, #44
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            dec b
            ld a, e
            inc a
            cp 2
            jr nz, sn_pl
            ld a, #40               ; #40, #43 the game's again
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (sn_vals + 1)
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (sn_vals)
            out (c), a
            ld bc, #123B
            in a, (c)
            ld (sn_l2), a
            jr sn_end
@sn_regs:   db #43, #40, #6E, #6F, #6C, #6B, #2F, #30, #31, #15, #68, #69, #4A, #4C, #14
            db #12, #70, #16, #17, #71, 0
@sn_vals:   ds 20
@sn_pals:   ds 4
@sn_l2:     db 0
sn_end:
    ENDIF
#endasm
End Sub

Public Sub Back()
#asm
    IFNDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld hl, sn_regs + 2
            ld de, sn_vals + 2
            ld bc, #243B
bk_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, bk_pal
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (de)
            out (c), a
            dec b
            inc hl
            inc de
            jr bk_lp
bk_pal:
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (sn_vals)
            and #0F
            or #30
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #40
            out (c), a
            inc b
            xor a
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #44               ; two writes a colour, then the next
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld hl, sn_pals
            ld e, 4
bk_pl:
            ld a, (hl)
            out (c), a
            inc hl
            dec e
            jr nz, bk_pl
            dec b
            ld a, #40               ; #40, #43 the game's
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (sn_vals + 1)
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #43
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, (sn_vals)
            out (c), a
            ld bc, #123B
            ld a, (sn_l2)
            out (c), a
    ENDIF
#endasm
End Sub

' Yield: the hypervisor's turn (BDOS 12: CP/M's version - any call below 13 ends the slot's turn):
' the other slots run, then this one again
Public Sub Yield()
#asm
    IFNDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld (ny_sp), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld c, 12
            ei
            call 5
            di
            ld sp, (ny_sp)
            jr ny_end
ny_sp:      dw 0
@ls_h7:     db 0                    ; the task's own page in MMU slot 7 (TaskStart: NextReg #57)
@ls_stk:    dw ntc_cpmstack         ; GfxData.Load's stack (slot 7 borrowed): the platform's real one, empty then
ny_end:
    ENDIF
#endasm
End Sub

' Front: 1 if this slot is the one in front (BDOS 131 op 0: a slot's line - its state, in front,
' its program's name), 0 if not; the slot's number from its status strip ("[7] ": TaskInit)
Public Function Front() As Integer
#asm
    IFNDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld (nf_sp), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld c, 131
            ld de, nf_blk
            ei
            call 5
            di
            ld sp, (nf_sp)
            ld a, (nf_blk + 3)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            jr nf_end
nf_sp:      dw 0
@nf_blk:    db 0, 1
            ds 64
nf_end:
    ENDIF
#endasm
End Function

' LoadCity: (a CyborgOS task, once at the start) the city's data into memory: 0 done, 1 not enough
' free memory, 2 the store's pages not found, 3 LSCITY.DAT not found, 4 LSCITY.DAT too short or
' not one, 5 no three pages in a row for Layer 2, 6 not a ZX Spectrum Next (asked first, before
' any port is touched).
' LSCITY.DAT (tools/cosnext.sh): an AMSDOS header (CyborgOS reads past it), a record that says
' what's in it - "LSC1", n, m, the n NEX banks it holds, the m NEX data banks that are empty
' (all 0: not in the file) - then the n banks, 16K each: the NEX's data banks with something in
' them, gfxtool's bank 47 and a copy of the NEX's bank 5 (the first sprite patterns, named bank
' 60 here), those two last. It goes into the slot's store (BDOS 131 op 12: the hypervisor's
' 16K pages, this slot's while the game runs, their numbers at #FF00 on), n + 2 pages:
'   0 .. n - 1   the banks, as in the file
'   n            Layer 2's third page: Layer 2 is pages n - 2, n - 1, n - banks 47 and 60 are
'                read only by GfxData.Load, done before L2.Init - when they are one after the
'                other (Layer 2 is three banks in a row). Not bank 16 as in the NEX: that's
'                CyborgOS's (its console's Layer 2 is banks 12-16). L2Bank gives it
'   n + 1        all 0: the empty banks' pages map to it
' The store's pages are the hypervisor's Memory pages - 16K bank = the first free bank + page - 2
' - and the first free bank isn't known here, so the program's first 16 bytes go into the
' store's first block (op 13) and the banks it can be (this slot's own first bank less a
' multiple of 4: slots are 64K banks from it) are looked at until they turn up. The file is
' looked for on the slot's drive, else on the first of A: to P: that has it (a new slot's drive
' is the boot drive; the folder the game was run from is a letter of its own: CD's), read 128
' bytes at a time (BDOS 20) and copied into the pages through MMU slot 6. Then the page table at
' #BF00: a page as the NEX has it -> the 8K page it is in now. On the real stack the whole way
' (calls, BDOS)
Public Function LoadCity() As Integer
#asm
    IFNDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld (lc_sp), sp
            ld sp, (ntc_csp)
            ld a, 5                 ; the machine (BDOS 131 op 20, 5: 0 a CPC, 1 a ZX Spectrum Next)
            ld (lc_blk + 1), a      ; - before any port is touched
            ld a, 20
            ld (lc_blk), a
            ld c, 131
            ld de, lc_blk
            call lc_bdos
            dec a
            ld e, 6
            jp nz, lc_end6
            ld hl, #BF00            ; the page table: each page itself to start with
lc_id:
            ld (hl), l
            inc l
            jp p, lc_id
            ld c, 26                ; the DMA: lc_buf
            ld de, lc_buf
            call lc_bdos
            ld c, 15                ; LSCITY.DAT opened: this slot's drive, else A: ... P:
            ld de, lc_fcb
            call lc_bdos
            inc a
            jr nz, lc_open
            xor a
            ld (lc_d), a
lc_dr:
            ld a, (lc_d)
            ld e, a
            ld c, 14                ; (BDOS 14: the slot's drive)
            call lc_bdos
            ld c, 15
            ld de, lc_fcb
            call lc_bdos
            inc a
            jr nz, lc_open
            ld hl, lc_d
            inc (hl)
            ld a, (hl)
            cp 16
            jr nz, lc_dr
            ld e, 3
            jp lc_ret
lc_open:
            ld c, 20                ; what's in it
            ld de, lc_fcb
            call lc_bdos
            or a
            ld e, 4
            jp nz, lc_ret
            ld hl, lc_buf
            ld de, lc_hdr
            ld bc, 128
            ldir
            ld hl, (lc_hdr)
            ld de, 'L' + 'S' * 256
            or a
            sbc hl, de
            ld e, 4
            jp nz, lc_ret
            ld a, (lc_hdr + 4)      ; n + 2 pages: (n + 2) * 16 K
            add a, 2
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld (lc_blk + 2), hl
            ld a, 12                ; op 12: the store
            call lc_sys
            or a
            ld e, 1
            jp nz, lc_ret
            ld hl, 0                ; op 13: 16 bytes from #0100 into block 0
            ld (lc_blk + 2), hl
            ld hl, #0100
            ld (lc_blk + 6), hl
            ld hl, 16
            ld (lc_blk + 8), hl
            ld a, 13
            call lc_sys
            ld a, #50               ; this slot's first 16K bank
            call lc_rd
            srl a
            ld (lc_k), a
lc_scan:
            ld a, (lc_k)
            ld hl, #FF00
            add a, (hl)
            sub 2
            jr c, lc_next
            cp 112
            jr nc, lc_next
            add a, a
            call lc_map
            ld hl, #C000
            ld de, #0100
            ld b, 16
lc_cmp:
            ld a, (de)
            cp (hl)
            jr nz, lc_next
            inc hl
            inc de
            djnz lc_cmp
            jr lc_found
lc_next:
            ld a, (lc_k)
            sub 4
            ld e, 2
            jp c, lc_ret
            ld (lc_k), a
            jr lc_scan
lc_found:
            xor a
            ld (lc_i), a
lc_bank:
            ld a, (lc_i)            ; store page i's first 8K page
            call lc_pgof
            ld (lc_pg), a
            xor a
            ld (lc_r), a
lc_rec:
            ld c, 20
            ld de, lc_fcb
            call lc_bdos
            or a
            ld e, 4
            jp nz, lc_ret
            ld a, (lc_r)            ; record r: page + r / 64, #C000 + (r and 63) * 128
            rlca
            rlca
            and 1
            ld hl, lc_pg
            add a, (hl)
            call lc_map
            ld a, (lc_r)
            and 63
            ld l, 0
            srl a
            rr l
            add a, #C0
            ld h, a
            ex de, hl
            ld hl, lc_buf
            ld bc, 128
            ldir
            ld hl, lc_r
            inc (hl)
            jp p, lc_rec            ; (128 records: 16K)
            ld a, (lc_i)            ; the page table: the NEX's bank -> these two pages
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, lc_hdr + 6
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, a
            ld a, (lc_pg)
            call lc_tab
            ld hl, lc_i
            inc (hl)
            ld a, (lc_hdr + 4)
            cp (hl)
            jr nz, lc_bank
            ld c, 16
            ld de, lc_fcb
            call lc_bdos
            ld a, (lc_hdr + 4)      ; page n + 1: all 0, the empty banks' pages
            inc a
            call lc_pgof
            ld (lc_pg), a
            call lc_map
            call lc_clr
            ld a, (lc_pg)
            inc a
            call lc_map
            call lc_clr
            ld a, (lc_hdr + 5)
            or a
            jr z, lc_lay
            ld b, a
            ld a, (lc_hdr + 4)
            ld e, a
            ld d, 0
            ld hl, lc_hdr + 6
            add hl, de
lc_empty:
            push bc
            push hl
            ld b, (hl)
            ld a, (lc_pg)
            call lc_tab
            pop hl
            pop bc
            inc hl
            djnz lc_empty
lc_lay:
            ld a, (lc_hdr + 4)      ; Layer 2: pages n - 2, n - 1, n in a row?
            sub 2
            ld l, a
            ld h, #FF
            ld a, (hl)
            inc a
            inc l
            cp (hl)
            ld e, 5
            jr nz, lc_ret
            inc a
            inc l
            cp (hl)
            jr nz, lc_ret
            ld a, (lc_hdr + 4)
            sub 2
            call lc_pgof
            ld (l2pg_a + 1), a      ; its first 8K page into the drawing routines
            ld (l2pg_b + 1), a
            ld (l2pg_c + 1), a
            ld (l2pg_d + 1), a
            srl a
            ld (lc_l2), a           ; its 16K bank (NextReg #12)
            ld e, 0
lc_ret:
            ld a, 10                ; bank 5's first page in slot 6 again
            call lc_map
lc_end6:
            ld sp, (lc_sp)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
            jp lc_end
lc_pgof:                            ; A = a store page -> A = its first 8K page
            ld l, a
            ld h, #FF
            ld a, (lc_k)
            add a, (hl)
            sub 2
            add a, a
            ret
lc_tab:                             ; NEX bank B -> 8K pages A, A + 1 in the table
            push af
            ld a, b
            add a, a
            ld l, a
            ld h, #BF
            pop af
            ld (hl), a
            inc l
            inc a
            ld (hl), a
            ret
lc_clr:                             ; #C000-#DFFF all 0
            ld hl, #C000
            ld de, #C001
            ld bc, #1FFF
            ld (hl), 0
            ldir
            ret
lc_sys:                             ; BDOS 131, op A, the block lc_blk: A back
            ld (lc_blk), a
            xor a
            ld (lc_blk + 1), a
            ld c, 131
            ld de, lc_blk
lc_bdos:                            ; BDOS C, DE: A back
            ei
            call 5
            di
            ret
lc_map:                             ; MMU slot 6 = page A
            push bc
            ld bc, #243B
            push af
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            pop af
            out (c), a
            pop bc
            ret
lc_rd:                              ; NextReg A: A
            ld bc, #243B
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            ret
lc_sp:      dw 0
lc_k:       db 0
lc_d:       db 0
@lc_l2:     db 16
lc_i:       db 0
lc_r:       db 0
lc_pg:      db 0
lc_fcb:     db 0, "LSCITY  DAT"
            ds 24
lc_buf:     equ #E000               ; (the slot's own top page below CyborgOS's stub at #EF00:
lc_hdr:     equ #E080               ; free while the city loads)
lc_blk:     equ #E100
lc_end:
    ENDIF
#endasm
End Function

' L2Bank: (a CyborgOS task) Layer 2's first 16K bank (LoadCity)
Public Function L2Bank() As Integer
#asm
    IFNDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld a, (lc_l2)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), a
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
    ENDIF
#endasm
End Function

' TaskInit: (a CyborgOS task) its own page in slot 7 noted (ls_h7: what the routines that borrow slot
' 7 put back), bank 5's first page in slot 6 (the tilemap: map and tiles)
Public Sub TaskInit()
#asm
    IFNDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #57
            out (c), a
            inc b
            in a, (c)
            ld (ls_h7), a
            dec b
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            ld hl, #F68B            ; the slot's number: its status strip "[7] ", "[12]"
            ld a, (hl)
            sub '0'
            ld e, a
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            sub '0'
            cp 10
            jr nc, ti_one
            ld d, a                 ; two digits: e * 10 + d
            ld a, e
            add a, a
            ld e, a
            add a, a
            add a, a
            add a, e
            add a, d
            ld e, a
ti_one:
            ld a, e
            ld (nf_blk + 1), a
            ASSERT ntc_free <= #BF00, "a task's program and arrays must end below #BF00 (the page table)"
    ENDIF
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Spr.cls
files.text:
' Spr - the Next's 128 hardware sprites, straight on the ports (#303B slot, #57 attributes).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' 4 bit patterns (GfxData.Load puts them in the sprite RAM), 16 x 16 pixels, scaled 1x - 8x.
' Put / Hide write a table in RAM; Show sends the table to the hardware in one go (do it just
' after Frame, so nothing moves half way down the screen).
' Coordinates are the tilemap's: 0, 0 is the top left of the whole 320 x 256 picture (the
' border included); the 256 x 192 paper is 32 - 287 across, 32 - 223 down. A sprite at x -16 .. or
' y -16 .. wraps (512): keep it hidden instead.
Option Explicit

' flags for Put: add them
Public Const MirrorX = 8
Public Const MirrorY = 4
Public Const Rotate = 2
Public Const Scale2X = &H800
Public Const Scale2Y = &H200
Public Const Scale2 = &HA00
Public Const Scale4X = &H1000
Public Const Scale4Y = &H400
Public Const Scale4 = &H1400
' a palette offset: Pal * n (n 0 - 15: spr_pal.png's row n)
Public Const Pal = 16

Private tab(639) As Byte          ' 128 x 5 attribute bytes
Private used As Integer           ' the highest slot Put + 1 (Show sends that many)

' Init: every sprite hidden, sprites on (over the border too), transparent colour 15
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 639
    tab(i) = 0
  Next
  For i = 3 To 639 Step 5
    tab(i) = &H40                ' hidden, but still 5 bytes (the upload stays in step)
  Next
  used = 128
  Show
  used = 0
  Nx.Reg &H4B, &HF               ' 4 bit sprites: colour 15 is transparent
  Nx.Reg &H15, (Nx.RegGet(&H15) And &H1C) Or 3   ' sprites on, over the border; the order kept
End Sub

' Put n, x, y, pattern, flags: sprite n (0-127) at x, y showing pattern (0-127), with flags
' (MirrorX + Scale2 + Pal * 2 ...)
Public Sub Put(ByVal n As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal pattern As Integer, ByVal flags As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld c, a
            inc a
            ld hl, {used}
            cp (hl)
            jr c, sp_low
            ld (hl), a
sp_low:
            ld l, c                 ; DE = tab + n * 5
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab}
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl                  ; x
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 0: x bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld c, a                 ; x bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; y
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 1: y bits 0-7
            inc hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 1
            ld b, a                 ; y bit 8
            inc de
            pop hl                  ; pattern
            ld a, (hl)
            ex af, af'
            pop hl                  ; flags
            ld a, (hl)
            and #FE
            or c
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 2: palette offset, mirrors, rotate, x bit 8
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; scale bits
            ex af, af'
            ld l, a
            srl a
            or #C0
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 3: visible, 5 bytes, pattern bits 6-1
            inc de
            ld a, l
            and 1
            rrca
            rrca
            or #80
            or b
            ld b, a
            ld a, c
            and #1E
            or b
            ld (de), a              ; attribute 4: 4 bit, pattern bit 0, scale, y bit 8
#endasm
End Sub

' Hide n: sprite n not shown
Public Sub Hide(ByVal n As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld (hl), #40            ; not visible, 5 bytes kept (else the upload slips a byte)
#endasm
End Sub

' HideRange first, count: those sprites not shown
Public Sub HideRange(ByVal first As Integer, ByVal count As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, hr_done
            ld b, a
            ex de, hl
            ld de, 5
hr_lp:
            ld (hl), #40
            add hl, de
            djnz hr_lp
hr_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Show: the table to the hardware (the slots up to the highest one Put)
Public Sub Show()
#asm
            ld a, ({used})
            or a
            jr z, sh_done
            ld bc, #303B
            xor a
            out (c), a
            ld a, ({used})
            ld e, a                 ; E sprites, 5 bytes each
            ld hl, {tab}
            ld c, #57
sh_lp:
            ld b, 5
            otir
            dec e
            jr nz, sh_lp
sh_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Visible(n): True when sprite n is shown
Public Function Visible(ByVal n As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            and 127
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld de, {tab} + 3
            add hl, de
            ld a, (hl)
            ld de, 0
            and #80
            jr z, vi_no
            dec de
vi_no:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), d
#endasm
End Function

files.name: Tiles.cls
files.text:
' Tiles - the Next's tilemap as a 4 bit picture: 40 x 32 cells of 8 x 8 pixels over the whole
' 320 x 256 display (the border included), 16 colours (tile_pal.png), colour 15 transparent.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' The map stays where the platform put it (bank 5 + #2000, seen at #E000: one byte a cell, the
' tile number), so Print and Locate still work on it: the font is tiles 32-126 (a character's code
' is its tile). The tile definitions go to bank 5 + #0000 (#C000-#DFFF, 32 bytes a tile): the
' ULA screen's place, so the ULA is turned off. Don't use Mode or Cls after Init (Mode puts the
' platform's own text tiles back; Cls is all right but fills with tile 32).
' Print near the right edge or the last row wraps and scrolls: end prints with ; and keep them
' off row 32 and column 40.
Option Explicit

Public Const Cols = 40
Public Const Rows = 32
Private Const MAPA = &HE000

' Init: the tilemap on, 40 x 32, 4 bit tiles from #C000, no attribute bytes, over the ULA;
' the ULA off; no scroll; the whole picture
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H68, Nx.RegGet(&H68) Or &H80     ' the ULA off (its screen's RAM holds the tiles)
#If NTC_ZXN Then
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H20                         ' the map: bank 5 + #2000
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &H0                          ' the tile definitions: bank 5 + #0000
#Else
  Nx.Reg &H6E, &H0                          ' (a CyborgOS task: the map at bank 5 + #0000, the tiles at
  Nx.Reg &H6F, &HC                          ' + #0C00 - bank 5's second page is the hypervisor's console)
#End If
  Nx.Reg &H6C, 0                            ' every cell: palette offset 0, no mirror
  Nx.Reg &H4C, &HF                          ' colour 15 transparent
  Nx.Reg &H2F, 0 : Nx.Reg &H30, 0 : Nx.Reg &H31, 0
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 8                            ' the clip window: all of it
  Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 159 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 0 : Nx.Reg &H1B, 255
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &HA1                         ' on, 40 x 32, no attributes, 4 bit, over the ULA
End Sub

' Put x, y, t: cell x (0-39), y (0-31) shows tile t
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)              ; y
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de              ; y * 40
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Get(x, y): the tile in cell x, y
Public Function Get(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ld e, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' At(px, py): the tile under pixel px, py (0-319, 0-255), 0 off the map
Public Function At(ByVal px As Integer, ByVal py As Integer) As Integer
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; px
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; py
            ld a, b
            or a
            jr nz, at_off
            ld a, d
            cp 2
            jr nc, at_off
            ld hl, -320
            add hl, de
            jr c, at_off
            srl d                   ; px / 8
            rr e
            srl e
            srl e
            ld a, c
            and #F8                 ; (py / 8) * 8
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            ld b, h
            ld c, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, bc              ; (py / 8) * 40
            ld d, #E0
            add hl, de
            ld e, (hl)
            jr at_set
at_off:
            ld e, 0
at_set:
            pop hl
            ld (hl), e
            inc hl
            ld (hl), 0
#endasm
End Function

' Fill t: every cell tile t
Public Sub Fill(ByVal t As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
            ld bc, 40 * 32 - 1
            ld (hl), a
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t: a block of cells
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Text x, y, s: text from cell x, y (the font tiles), no wrap, no scroll
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, #E0
            add hl, bc
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
tx_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, tx_done
            ld (de), a
            inc hl
            inc de
            ld a, d
            cp #E5                  ; past the map's end (#E500)
            jr nc, tx_done
            jr tx_lp
tx_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Scroll x, y: the tilemap moved by x (0-319) and y (0-255) pixels
Public Sub Scroll(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
  Nx.Reg &H2F, (x \ 256) And 3
  Nx.Reg &H30, x And 255
  Nx.Reg &H31, y And 255
End Sub

files.name: Sfx.cls
files.text:
' Sfx - sound effects on the Next's AY chip (the first of its three), straight on the ports:
' #FFFD picks a register, #BFFD writes it. Three channels, each playing one effect at a time:
' a tone or noise whose pitch slides and whose volume fades to nothing over its length.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
' Call Update once a frame (50 a second).
'   Sfx.Play 0, 200, 8, 15, 12, 0     ' channel A: tone period 200, rising pitch... 12 frames
Option Explicit

Private per(2) As Integer         ' the tone period now (12 bits; noise: 0-31)
Private slide(2) As Integer       ' added to it each frame
Private vol(2) As Integer         ' the volume it starts at (0-15)
Private total(2) As Integer       ' its length in frames
Private left(2) As Integer        ' frames to go (0 = silent)
Private nse(2) As Integer         ' 1 = noise, 0 = tone
Private mix As Integer

Private Sub W(ByVal r As Integer, ByVal v As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld bc, #FFFD
            out (c), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld b, #BF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Init: AY 1 picked (the Next has three: Turbosound), every channel quiet
Public Sub Init()
  Dim i As Integer
  Out &HFFFD, &HFF                 ' AY 1 (Turbosound: #FF, #FE, #FD pick the chips)
  For i = 0 To 13
    W i, 0
  Next
  W 7, &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
  Next
End Sub

' Play ch, period, slidePerFrame, volume, frames, noise: start an effect on channel ch (0-2)
Public Sub Play(ByVal ch As Integer, ByVal period As Integer, ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal volume As Integer, ByVal frames As Integer, ByVal noise As Integer)
  If ch < 0 Or ch > 2 Then Exit Sub
  per(ch) = period : slide(ch) = sl : vol(ch) = volume : total(ch) = frames : left(ch) = frames : nse(ch) = noise
End Sub

' Busy(ch): True while channel ch plays
Public Function Busy(ByVal ch As Integer) As Integer
  Busy = (left(ch) > 0)
End Function

' Update: once a frame - the pitches slide, the volumes fade, the AY written
Public Sub Update()
  Dim i As Integer, v As Integer, p As Integer
  mix = &H3F
  For i = 0 To 2
    If left(i) > 0 Then
      v = (vol(i) * left(i) + total(i) - 1) \ total(i)
      p = per(i)
      If nse(i) Then
        W 6, p And 31
        mix = mix And Not (8 * (2 ^ i))
      Else
        W i * 2, p And 255
        W i * 2 + 1, (p \ 256) And 15
        mix = mix And Not (2 ^ i)
      End If
      W 8 + i, v
      per(i) = per(i) + slide(i)
      If per(i) < 1 Then per(i) = 1
      left(i) = left(i) - 1
    Else
      W 8 + i, 0
    End If
  Next
  W 7, mix
End Sub

' Quiet: every channel stopped
Public Sub Quiet()
  Dim i As Integer
  For i = 0 To 2
    left(i) = 0
    W 8 + i, 0
  Next
End Sub

files.name: Board.cls
files.text:
' Board - the card table on the Next's tilemap: 40 x 32 cells, 2 bytes each (the tile, its palette
' row), so each card can be in its own colours. The tiles (GfxData) at bank 5 + #0000, the map at
' bank 5 + #2000 (#E000). As a CyborgOS task the map is at bank 5 + #0000 (#C000) and the tiles at
' bank 5 + #0C00: bank 5's second page is the hypervisor's console.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Private tc As Integer

' Init: the tilemap with attributes (after Tiles.Init and GfxData.Load)
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H6B, &H81                        ' the tilemap: on, 40 x 32, 2 bytes a cell, 4 bit
  Clear
End Sub

' Clear: every cell tile 0 (see-through)
Public Sub Clear()
#asm
    IFDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld hl, #E000
            ld de, #E001
    ELSE
            ld hl, #C000            ; (task: the map at bank 5 + #0000, in slot 6)
            ld de, #C001
    ENDIF
            ld bc, 2559
            ld (hl), 0
            ldir
#endasm
End Sub

' Put x, y, t, p: cell x, y shows tile t in palette row p
Public Sub Put(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal t As Integer, ByVal p As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a                 ; DE = #E000 + (y * 40 + x) * 2
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, 0
            add hl, bc
            add hl, hl
    IFDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld de, #E000
    ELSE
            ld de, #C000
    ENDIF
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld (de), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Text x, y, s, p: a string from cell x, y in palette row p (the font is the tiles 32-95)
Public Sub Text(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal p As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld l, a
            ld h, 0
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            add hl, hl
            add hl, hl
            add hl, de
            ld b, 0
            add hl, bc
            add hl, hl
    IFDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld de, #E000
    ELSE
            ld de, #C000
    ENDIF
            add hl, de
            ex de, hl
            pop hl
            ld ({tc}), hl
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and #F0
            ld c, a
            ld hl, ({tc})
st_lp:
            ld a, (hl)
            or a
            jr z, st_done
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            ld a, c
            ld (de), a
            inc de
            inc hl
            ld a, d
    IFDEF NTC_ZXN
            cp #EA
    ELSE
            cp #CA
    ENDIF
            jr nc, st_done
            jr st_lp
st_done:
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, t, p: a block of one tile
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal t As Integer, ByVal p As Integer)
  Dim i As Integer, j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    For i = x To x + w - 1
      Put i, j, t, p
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Pal row, s: the tilemap's palette row (0-15) from s, 16 colours as hex pairs (RRRGGGBB)
Public Sub Pal(ByVal row As Integer, ByVal s As String)
  Dim k As Integer
  For k = 0 To 15
    Nx.PalEntry Nx.PalTiles, row * 16 + k, Hx(s, k)
  Next
End Sub

' Hx(s, k): the k-th hex pair in s
Private Function Hx(ByVal s As String, ByVal k As Integer) As Integer
  Dim a As Integer, b As Integer
  a = Asc(Mid$(s, k * 2 + 1, 1)) : b = Asc(Mid$(s, k * 2 + 2, 1))
  If a > 57 Then a = a - 55 Else a = a - 48
  If b > 57 Then b = b - 55 Else b = b - 48
  Hx = a * 16 + b
End Function

files.name: L2.cls
files.text:
' L2 - Layer 2 for the backdrops: 256 x 192, one byte a pixel (RRRGGGBB colours), bank 16 (pages
' 32-37, each 32 lines, put in at #C000 through MMU slot 6 while drawing, then bank 5's page 10
' back). Behind the tilemap and the sprites. As a CyborgOS task its three banks are its own, from
' the hypervisor (Nx.LoadCity, Nx.L2Bank: bank 16 is CyborgOS's), patched into the routines here
' and in World.cls (l2pg_a - l2pg_d).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Private sc As Integer, sw As Integer, fa As Integer

' Init: Layer 2 on, 256 x 192, no scroll, the whole of it
Public Sub Init()
  Nx.Reg &H70, 0
#If NTC_ZXN Then
  Nx.Reg &H12, 16
#Else
  Nx.Reg &H12, Nx.L2Bank()                      ' (a CyborgOS task: its own three banks - Nx.LoadCity)
#End If
  Nx.Reg &H1C, 1
  Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 255 : Nx.Reg &H18, 0 : Nx.Reg &H18, 191
  Nx.Reg &H16, 0 : Nx.Reg &H17, 0
  Out &H123B, 2
End Sub

' Span x, y, w, c: w pixels (1-256, not past the right edge) of colour c from x, y
Public Sub Span(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)              ; x
            pop hl
            ld d, (hl)              ; y
            pop hl
            ld c, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld b, (hl)              ; w
            ld ({sw}), bc
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({sc}), a            ; colour
            ld a, d
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
@l2pg_a: add a, 32           ; (Layer 2's first 8K page; a CyborgOS task: its own, LoadCity patches it)
            ld h, a                 ; the page: 32 + y / 32
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, h
            out (c), a
            ld a, d
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
            ld l, e                 ; HL = #C000 + (y And 31) * 256 + x
            ld bc, ({sw})
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr z, l2_back
            ld a, ({sc})
            ld (hl), a
            dec bc
            ld a, b
            or c
            jr z, l2_back
            ld d, h
            ld e, l
            inc de
            ldir
l2_back:
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Rect x, y, w, h, c: a block
Public Sub Rect(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  Dim j As Integer
  For j = y To y + h - 1
    Span x, j, w, c
  Next
End Sub

' Plot x, y, c: one pixel
Public Sub Plot(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal c As Integer)
  If x >= 0 And x < 256 And y >= 0 And y < 192 Then Span x, y, 1, c
End Sub

' Big x, y, s, z, c1, c2: text s drawn z times the size, colour c1 on top shading to c2, with a
' dark shadow (colour 0) two pixels down and right. The letters are read from the tilemap's font
' (tiles 32-95 at #C000, 4 bits a pixel: colour 1 is the letter)
Public Sub Big(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal s As String, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal c1 As Integer, ByVal c2 As Integer)
  Dim k As Integer, r As Integer, b As Integer, i As Integer, run As Integer, a As Integer, col As Integer, pass As Integer, sh As Integer, m As Integer, v As Integer
  For pass = 0 To 1
    sh = (1 - pass) * 2
    For k = 1 To Len(s)
      a = &HC000 + Asc(Mid$(s, k, 1)) * 32
      For r = 0 To 7
        b = 0 : m = 128
        For i = 0 To 3
          v = Peek(a + r * 4 + i)
          If (v \ 16) = 1 Then b = b Or m
          If (v And 15) = 1 Then b = b Or (m \ 2)
          m = m \ 4
        Next
        col = 0
        If pass Then
          col = c2
          If r < 4 Then col = c1
        End If
        i = 0
        Do While b
          If b And 128 Then
            run = 0
            Do While b And 128
              run = run + 1 : b = (b * 2) And 255
            Loop
            Rect x + ((k - 1) * 8 + i) * z + sh, y + r * z + sh, run * z, z, col
            i = i + run
          Else
            i = i + 1 : b = (b * 2) And 255
          End If
        Loop
      Next
    Next
  Next
End Sub

' Tint x, y, w, h: the pixels in that box a shade warmer (red and green up a step: a marked
' block), not past the screen's edges
Public Sub Tint(ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal w As Integer, ByVal h As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (tn_x + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({fa}), a            ; y
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (tn_w + 1), a
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({sw}), a            ; h
tn_row:
            ld a, ({fa})
            ld d, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, d
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
@l2pg_b: add a, 32           ; (Layer 2's first 8K page; a CyborgOS task: its own, LoadCity patches it)
            out (c), a
            ld a, d
            and 31
            or #C0
            ld h, a
tn_x:
            ld l, 0
tn_w:
            ld b, 0
tn_px:
            ld a, (hl)
            ld c, a
            and #E0
            cp #E0
            jr z, tn_g
            ld a, c
            add a, #20
            ld c, a
tn_g:
            ld a, c
            and #1C
            cp #1C
            jr z, tn_put
            ld a, c
            add a, 4
            ld c, a
tn_put:
            ld a, c
            cp #E3
            jr nz, tn_ok
            dec a
tn_ok:
            ld (hl), a
            inc l
            djnz tn_px
            ld hl, {fa}
            inc (hl)
            ld hl, {sw}
            dec (hl)
            jr nz, tn_row
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

files.name: Face.cls
files.text:
' Face - a person's face (and a witch's hat) put together from sprite parts (15 sprites from a slot): the clothes, the
' face, the mouth, the eyes, the hair and an accessory, each in its own palette row (skin, hair
' and eye colours), from their look. 32 x 32 pixels, or 2x / 4x.
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Public Const SPRITES = 17

' Put sl, a, x, y, z, mo: the face whose look (9 bytes: face, skin, hair, hair colour, eyes, eye
' colour, mouth, accessory, outfit) is at address a, in sprite slots sl .. sl + 14, its top left
' at x, y (sprite coordinates: the paper's top left is 32, 32), z times the size (1, 2 or 4);
' mo: a mouth instead of its own (0-5: smile, open, cat, o, grin, smirk), or -1; h: a witch's hat
' (0 none, 1 or 2: the style) in slots sl + 15, sl + 16
Public Sub Put(ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal a As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal z As Integer, ByVal mo As Integer, ByVal h As Integer)
  Dim fl As Integer, q As Integer, sk As Integer, ac As Integer, p As Integer
  fl = 0
  If z = 2 Then fl = Spr.Scale2
  If z = 4 Then fl = Spr.Scale4
  q = 16 * z
  sk = Spr.Pal * (1 + Peek(a + 1))
  p = FaceSet.S_OUTFIT + Peek(a + 8) * 2
  Spr.Put sl, x, y + q, p, fl
  Spr.Put sl + 1, x + q, y + q, p + 1, fl
  Four sl + 2, x, y, FaceSet.S_FACE + Peek(a) * 4, fl + sk, q
  If mo < 0 Then mo = Peek(a + 6)
  Spr.Put sl + 6, x + 8 * z, y + q, FaceSet.S_MOUTH + mo, fl + sk
  p = FaceSet.S_EYES + Peek(a + 4) * 2
  Spr.Put sl + 7, x, y + 8 * z, p, fl + Spr.Pal * (12 + Peek(a + 5))
  Spr.Put sl + 8, x + q, y + 8 * z, p + 1, fl + Spr.Pal * (12 + Peek(a + 5))
  Four sl + 9, x, y, FaceSet.S_HAIR + Peek(a + 2) * 4, fl + Spr.Pal * (4 + Peek(a + 3)), q
  ac = Peek(a + 7)
  Spr.Hide sl + 14
  Select Case ac
    Case 0
      Spr.Hide sl + 13
    Case 6
      Spr.Put sl + 13, x, y + 8 * z, FaceSet.S_GLASSES, fl
      Spr.Put sl + 14, x + q, y + 8 * z, FaceSet.S_GLASSES + 1, fl
    Case 1
      Spr.Put sl + 13, x + 14 * z, y - 4 * z, FaceSet.S_ACC, fl
    Case 3
      Spr.Put sl + 13, x + z, y + 3 * z, FaceSet.S_ACC + 2, fl
    Case 5
      Spr.Put sl + 13, x + 16 * z, y + 10 * z, FaceSet.S_ACC2, fl
    Case Else
      Spr.Put sl + 13, x + 19 * z, y + (ac - 1) * z, FaceSet.S_ACC + ac - 1, fl
  End Select
  If h Then
    p = FaceSet.S_HAT + h * 2 - 2
    Spr.Put sl + 15, x, y - 6 * z, p, fl
    Spr.Put sl + 16, x + q, y - 6 * z, p + 1, fl
  Else
    Spr.HideRange sl + 15, 2
  End If
End Sub

' Hide sl: the face in slots sl .. sl + 14 gone
Public Sub Hide(ByVal sl As Integer)
  Spr.HideRange sl, SPRITES
End Sub

' four sprites: a 32 x 32 part (16 x 16 cells TL, TR, BL, BR)
Private Sub Four(ByVal sl As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer, ByVal p As Integer, ByVal fl As Integer, ByVal q As Integer)
  Spr.Put sl, x, y, p, fl
  Spr.Put sl + 1, x + q, y, p + 1, fl
  Spr.Put sl + 2, x, y + q, p + 2, fl
  Spr.Put sl + 3, x + q, y + q, p + 3, fl
End Sub

' World - LITTLE SEOUL's screens on Layer 2: 16 x 12 blocks of 16 x 16 pixels, each block a 256-byte
' picture in the Next's other RAM (tools/blocks.py), 32 to an 8K page from Init's page on. Drawing
' puts Layer 2's page in MMU slot 6 and a block's page in slot 7, then bank 5 back (10, 11).
' Also the map: a screen drawn as 16 x 12 dots, a dot a block (its colour from a table).
' (c) 2026 Cyborg Unicorn Pty Ltd - MIT License
Option Explicit

Private bpg As Integer, rr As Integer, cc As Integer, kk As Integer, dst As Integer, dp As Integer, tb As Integer

' Init page: the blocks start at 8K page page
Public Sub Init(ByVal page As Integer)
  bpg = page
End Sub

' Draw a: the screen whose 192 block numbers are at address a (rows of 16)
Public Sub Draw(ByVal a As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({dp}), de
            xor a
            ld ({rr}), a
dr_row:
            ld a, ({rr})            ; Layer 2's page for this row of blocks: 32 + row / 2
            srl a
@l2pg_c: add a, 32           ; (Layer 2's first 8K page; a CyborgOS task: its own, LoadCity patches it)
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            xor a
            ld ({cc}), a
dr_cell:
            ld hl, ({dp})
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld ({dp}), hl
            ld e, a                 ; E = the block
            rlca                    ; its page: bpg + block / 32
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
            ld d, a
            ld a, ({bpg})
            add a, d
            ld d, a
    IFNDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld h, #BF               ; (task: the block's page from the page table)
            ld l, d
            ld d, (hl)
    ENDIF
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #57
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), d
            ld a, e                 ; HL = #E000 + (block and 31) * 256
            and 31
            add a, #E0
            ld h, a
            ld l, 0
            ld a, ({rr})            ; the place: #C000 + (row and 1) * #1000 + column * 16
            and 1
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            add a, #C0
            ld ({dst} + 1), a
            ld a, ({cc})
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            ld ({dst}), a
            ld a, 16
            ld ({kk}), a
dr_line:
            ld de, ({dst})
            ld bc, 16
            ldir
            ld a, ({dst} + 1)
            inc a
            ld ({dst} + 1), a
            ld a, ({kk})
            dec a
            ld ({kk}), a
            jr nz, dr_line
            ld a, ({cc})
            inc a
            ld ({cc}), a
            cp 16
            jr nz, dr_cell
            ld a, ({rr})
            inc a
            ld ({rr}), a
            cp 12
            jp nz, dr_row
            ld bc, #243B            ; bank 5 back in slots 6 and 7
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
            dec b
            ld a, #57
            out (c), a
            inc b
    IFDEF NTC_ZXN
            ld a, 11
    ELSE
            ld a, (ls_h7)           ; (task: its own page back in slot 7)
    ENDIF
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub

' Mini a, t, x, y: the screen whose blocks are at a as 16 x 12 dots at x, y on Layer 2 (y + 11 below
' 192), each dot the colour in table t (256 bytes: a block's colour)
Public Sub Mini(ByVal a As Integer, ByVal t As Integer, ByVal x As Integer, ByVal y As Integer)
#asm
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({dp}), de
            pop hl
            ld e, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld d, (hl)
            ld ({tb}), de
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({cc}), a            ; x
            pop hl
            ld a, (hl)
            ld ({rr}), a            ; y
            ld a, 12
            ld ({kk}), a
mi_row:
            ld a, ({rr})            ; the row's page (32 + y / 32) in slot 6
            rlca
            rlca
            rlca
            and 7
@l2pg_d: add a, 32           ; (Layer 2's first 8K page; a CyborgOS task: its own, LoadCity patches it)
            ld e, a
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            out (c), e
            ld a, ({rr})
            and 31
            add a, #C0
            ld d, a
            ld a, ({cc})
            ld e, a                 ; DE = the first dot
            ld b, 16
mi_dot:
            ld hl, ({dp})
            ld a, (hl)
            inc hl
            ld ({dp}), hl
            ld hl, ({tb})
            add a, l
            ld l, a
            ld a, 0
            adc a, h
            ld h, a
            ld a, (hl)
            ld (de), a
            inc e
            djnz mi_dot
            ld a, ({rr})
            inc a
            ld ({rr}), a
            ld a, ({kk})
            dec a
            ld ({kk}), a
            jr nz, mi_row
            ld bc, #243B
            ld a, #56
            out (c), a
            inc b
            ld a, 10
            out (c), a
#endasm
End Sub
